fields.title: Ayambadde Amaanyi n'Ekitiibwa
fields.description: Ayambadde Amaanyi n'Ekitiibwa kitabo ekiva ku mutima, ekiyamba abakyala Abakristaayo mu nsi yonna abaagala okutambulira wamu ne Katonda mu bumpi. Nga kisimbye emirandira gyakyo mu Byawandiikibwa era nga kijjudde amagezi, okusaba, n'okuzzaamu amaanyi okw'omugaso, ekitabo kino kyekenneenya ebikwata ku bwe tuli mu Kristo, okusaba, obufumbo, okuba maama, okuweereza, n'obulamu obw'okutya Katonda.

fields.title: Okusimba Emirandira mu Kristo: Obuntu Bwo Obw'Amazima
fields.body_html:
"Katonda n'atonda omuntu mu kifaananyi kye, mu kifaananyi kya Katonda mwe yamutondera; omusajja n'omukazi ye yabatonda." Olubereberye 1:27 (KJV) Nga tetunnaba kwogera ku ky'omukazi Omukristaayo ky'akola, tusooka kutegeera kye ali. Okutabukatabuka okungi mu bulamu bwaffe kuva mu kwerabira kye tuli ddala. Omukazi bw'atamanya kye ali mu Kristo, ajja kugezaako okunoonya omuwendo gwe mu balo, mu baana be, mu kusoma kwe, mu bulungi bwe, mu mulimu gwe, oba mu bantu abalala kye bagamba ku ye. Buli kimu ku bino kiyinza okuggibwako mu kaseera buseera. Naye kye Katonda ky'akuwa okuba tekiyinza kuggibwako n'akatono.

Ekyawandiikibwa kituyigiriza amazima amakulu asatu ku kye oli. Ekisooka, watondebwa mu kifaananyi kya Katonda.

Ekyokubiri, wanunulibwa n'omusaayi gwa Yesu Kristo. Ekyokusatu, ojjuzibbwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu era wayawulibwa olw'emirimu emirungi Katonda yennyini gye yateekateeka.

Lowooza ku mazima ag'olubereberye. Mu Olubereberye essuula 1, Katonda bwe yatonda ensi, yayogera emmunyeenye ne zibaawo, yajjuza ennyanja n'ebyennyanja n'eggulu n'ennyonyi, yakola ensolo ez'omu nsiko. Naye bwe yatuuka okutonda omuntu, yakola ekintu eky'enjawulo. Yagamba nti, "Tukole omuntu mu kifaananyi kyaffe, afaanane naffe." Awo ekyawandiikibwa kigamba mu bulambulukufu nti yabatonda omusajja n'omukazi, bombi mu kifaananyi kye. Kino kitegeeza nti, ng'omukazi, toli kifaananyi kya Katonda ekitono. Oli mutwazi w'ekifaananyi kya Katonda Omulamu ekituukiridde. Amagezi go, enneewulira zo, okwagala kwo, obusobozi bwo obw'okwagala, okutonda, okulowooza, n'okusinza — byonna bino biva eri Katonda era biraga ekimu ku butonde bwe.

Amazima ag'okubiri ge gano nti wanunulibwa. Okugwa kwa Adamu ne Kaawa kwaleeta ekibi n'okufa mu nsi, era ffenna twonoona ne tulemererwa okutuuka ku kitiibwa kya Katonda. Naye Katonda mu kusaasira kwe yatuma Omwana we omu yekka, Yesu Kristo, eyazaalibwa omukazi, eyabeera obulamu obutuukiridde, eyafiira ku musaalaba olw'ebibi byaffe, era eyazuukira ku lunaku olwokusatu. Bw'oteeka okukkiriza kwo mu Yesu, ebibi byo bisangulwa. Toli mulumirizibwa nate. Otwalibwa ng'omwana mu maka ga Katonda. Ekyawandiikibwa kigamba nti bonna abaamusembeza, yabawa obuyinza okufuuka abaana ba Katonda.

Lowooza ku kino kye kitegeeza. Oli muwala wa Kabaka wa bakabaka. Katonda oyo omu eyayimusa ensozi ennene, eyayanjuluza amazzi g'ennyanja zonna, eyawanika buli mmunyeenye mu ggulu — Katonda ono akuyita muwala we. Omutume Pawulo awandiika nti tuli basika ba Katonda era basika bannaawe ne Kristo. Embeera yo ey'oku nsi yonna nga bw'eri, oba obeera mu nnyumba entono erina akasolya akatonnya oba mu nnyumba ennene mu kibuga, obusika bwo obw'amazima buli mu ggulu, era businga wala kyonna ensi kye eyinza okuwa.

Amazima ag'okusatu ge gano nti olina Omwoyo Omutukuvu abeera munda yo. Bwe wajja eri Kristo, Katonda teyakuleka kugezaako kutuukiriza bulamu bw'Ekikristaayo mu maanyi go ggwe. Yakuwa Omwoyo we, akubudaabuda, akuyigiriza, akulaga ekibi, era akuwa amaanyi okutuukiriza obulamu obutukuvu. Omwoyo omu eyazuukiza Yesu okuva mu bafu abeera mu ggwe. Toli munafu. Ojjudde amaanyi ga Katonda amangi.

Ka nkulage amazima gano nga mpita mu bulamu bw'omukazi omu mu Bayibuli. Mu Njiri ya Yokaana, essuula ey'okuna, tusoma ku mukazi Omusamaliya. Yajja ku luzzi mu ttuntu, oboolyawo olw'ensonyi ez'okujja abakazi abalala lwe bajja mu makya. Yali afumbiddwa emirundi etaano, era omusajja gwe yali naye kaakati teyali balo we. Obulamu bwe bwali bumenyese.

Obuntu bwe bwali buzimbiddwa ku nkolagana ezaali zimulemererwa. Naye Yesu yamusanga ku luzzi. Yamanya buli kimu ku ye, kyokka teyamulumiriza. Yamuwa amazzi amalamu. Yamubuulira ani Masiya ow'amazima. N'adduka n'addayo mu kyalo kye n'abuulira buli muntu nti, "Mujje, mulabe omuntu ambuulidde byonna bye nakola." Bangi ne bakkiriza olw'obujulizi bwe. Omukazi oyo omu, eyali yeekwese ba muliraanwa be olw'ensonyi, yafuuka omubuulizi w'Enjiri asooka mu kyalo kye. Yesu yakyusa kye yali.

Oba lowooza ku Maliyamu Magudaleene. Ekyawandiikibwa kitugamba nti Yesu yamugobako baddayimooni musanvu. Nga tannasisinkana Yesu, yali abonaabona. Bwe yamala okusisinkana Yesu, yamugoberera, yawagira obuweereza bwe, yayimirira ku musaalaba abayigirizwa abasinga obungi nga badduse, era ye yali omuntu asooka okulaba Mukama azuukidde ku makya g'Okuzuukira. Oyo eyamumanya obulamba ye yamuwa erinnya eppya n'okuyitibwa okuppya.

Mu byafaayo by'Ekkanisa, tulaba amazima gano gaakolebwa mu ngeri ennungi. Lowooza ku Perupetuwa, omuwala Omwafirika ow'omu bukiikakkono eyali mu bulamu nga mu mwaka gwa 200 AD. Yali wa myaka abiri mu ebiri byokka, nnyabo omupya nga akyalina omwana ku bbeere, bwe yakwatibwa olw'okuba Omukristaayo. Kitaawe yamwegayirira aleke okukkiriza kwe awonye obulamu bwe. Yagaana.

Yawandiika ekitabo ky'olugero ng'ali mu kkomera ekikyaliwo n'okutuusa leero. Mu kyo, yawandiika nti yamanya kye yali — omuweereza omukazi wa Yesu Kristo. Obuntu obwo bwali bwa maanyi okusinga amaziga ga kitaawe, okusinga okwagala kwe eri omwana we ye, okusinga okutya okufa. Yagenda mu kifo eky'okulwaniramu nga ayimba Zabbuli n'afiira Mukama we. Ekkanisa ey'edda yajjukira erinnya lye okumala emyaka mingi. Obuntu bwe mu Kristo bwamuwa amaanyi ago agataayinza kuggyibwako.

Mwannyinaze, obuntu bwo buzimbiddwa ku ki leero? Bwe buba buzimbiddwa ku ndabika yo, bujja kuggwaawo. Bwe buba buzimbiddwa ku balo bye kye kya ku ggwe, ye musajja buntu era ayinza okukulemererwa. Bwe buba buzimbiddwa ku kuba abaana bo bakulaakulana, nabo bakyali boonoonyi abayinza okunakuwaza omutima gwo. Bwe buba buzimbiddwa ku baliraanwa bo bye balowooza, bajja kukusalira omusango ng'engeri ezikyukakyuka bwe ziri. Kristo yekka ye Lwazi.

Mu ye yekka obuntu bwo mwe butanyeenyezebwa.

Ffuna akaseera mu wiiki eno okufumiitiriza ku kye oli mu Kristo. Wandiika amazima gano. Gagambe waggulu. Oyinza okugamba nti, "Ndi muwala wa Katonda. Natondebwa mu kifaananyi kye. Nanunulibwa n'omusaayi gwa Yesu. Nzijjudde Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Njagalibwa n'okwagala okutaggwaawo. Tewali kintu kiyinza kunjawula ku kwagala kwa Katonda okuli mu Kristo Yesu Mukama wange." Omulabe bw'akwesera eby'obulimba, muddemu n'amazima ag'ekigambo kya Katonda.

Okusaba Kitange ali mu ggulu, nkwebaza olw'okuntonda mu kifaananyi kyo. Nkwebaza olw'okutuma Omwana wo Yesu okufa olw'ebibi byange n'okunfuula omuwala wo. Nkwebaza olw'Omwoyo wo abeera munda yange. Nsonyiwa olw'ebiseera bye nazimba obuntu bwange ku bintu ebitaliwo. Njigiriza leero okumanya kye ndi mu ggwe. Mpa obuvumu okutambulira mu mazima ago, ndyoke nkuwe ekitiibwa mu byonna bye nkola. Mu linnya lya Yesu Kristo, Mukama wange era Omulokozi wange, Amiina.

fields.title: Obuweereza Obw'amaanyi obw'Okusaba
fields.body_html:
"Musabenga awatali kulekeraawo." Abasessalonika Abasooka 5:17 (KJV) Mu mirimu gyonna omukazi Omukristaayo gy'ayinza okukola, tewali gwa maanyi kusinga kusaba. Omukazi ng'afukamidde ayinza okukyusa ebyafaayo. Ayinza okumenya ebigo by'omulabe. Ayinza okusengejja omukono gwa Katonda okuwonya, okulokola, okugabirira, n'okukuuma. Obwakabaka bulyawo bwazimbibwa era ne buggwaawo olw'abakazi abaasaba. Amaka mangi genkabwa gaaleeteddwa eri Kristo olw'okusaba okw'ekyama era okw'obwesigwa okwa maama oba jjajja omukazi. Toteekereza n'akatono nti okusaba mulimu mutono.

Baibuli etuwa ebiragiro ebitegeerekeka ku kusaba. Tuteekwa okusaba awatali kulekeraawo. Tuteekwa okusabira abalabe baffe n'abo abatuyigganya. Tuteekwa okusabira bakabaka n'abo bonna abali mu buyinza, tulyoke tube n'obulamu obw'emirembe era obuteekuteeka. Tuteekwa okusabiraganako tulyoke tuwonyezebwe.

Tuteekwa okusaba mu kyama, ne Kitaffe alaba mu kyama alituwa empeera mu lwatu. Tuteekwa okusaba n'okukkiriza, awatali kubuusabuusa. Tuteekwa okusaba mu linnya lya Yesu. Era tuteekwa okusaba mu maanyi g'Omwoyo Omutukuvu.

Ka nkulabise Kaana. Olugero lwe luli mu Samwiri Ow'olubereberye essuula esooka. Kaana yali afumbiddwa omusajja ayitibwa Erukaana, naye teyasobola kuzaala baana. Mu buwangwa obwo, kino kyali nsonyi nnyingi era nnaku nnyingi. Muggya we, Penina, yamusekereranga olw'ekyo. Buli mwaka, Kaana yalinnyanga mu weema ya Mukama e Siiro, era buli mwaka yakaabanga. Olunaku lumu, okusaba kwe kwakyusa buli kimu. Yayingira mu nnyumba ya Mukama n'afuka omutima gwe. Yasaba n'obunnya bungi n'emimwa gye ne ginyeenya naye eddoboozi ne litawulikika. Eri kabona n'alowooza nti atamidde, naye teyali atamidde mwenge — yali atamidde nnaku n'okwegomba okungi Katonda amuwulire. Yeeyama ekyeyamo: Katonda bwe yandimuwadde omwana ow'obulenzi, yandimuwaddeyo eri Mukama ennaku zonna ez'obulamu bwe.

Katonda yawulira Kaana. Yaba olubuto n'azaala Samwiri. Era Samwiri yakula n'afuuka omu ku bannabbi abasingira ddala obukulu mu byafaayo bya Isirayiri. Ye yafuka amafuta ku Kabaka Dawudi, omusajja eyakwatagana n'omutima gwa Katonda, gwe yava mu zzadde lye Yesu Masiya. Lowooza ku ekyo, mwannyinaze.

Olulyo lwonna olwa Kabaka Dawudi, olwatuusa ku kuzaalibwa kw'Omulokozi waffe, lwava mu kusaba okwaddibwamu okw'omukazi eyakaaba. Tonyoomanga amaziga go mu maaso ga Mukama.

Ne wabaawo Ana, mu Lukka essuula ey'okubiri. Yali mukazi mukadde, nnamwandu eyali amaze emyaka egisukka mu nkaaga bwe tumusanga. Ekyawandiikibwa kigamba nti teyavanga mu yeekaalu, naye yaweerezanga Katonda n'okusiiba n'okusaba emisana n'ekiro. Maliyamu ne Yusufu bwe baaleeta omwana omuto Yesu mu yeekaalu, Ana n'amulaba, n'ategeera oyo gwe yali, n'awa Katonda okwebaza. Emyaka gye egy'okusaba gyamuteekateeka okutegeera Masiya amangwago bwe yatuuka. Okusaba kutendeka amaaso go okulaba abalala bye batayinza kulaba.

Mukama Yesu yennyini yatuyigiriza engeri y'okusaba. Yatuyigiriza okutandika n'okusinza — "Erinnya lyo litukuzibwe." Yatuyigiriza okusabira Katonda by'ayagala — "Obwakabaka bwo bujje, by'oyagala bikolebwe." Yatuyigiriza okusaba ebyetaago byaffe ebya buli lunaku — "Otuwe leero emmere yaffe eya buli lunaku." Yatuyigiriza okunoonya okusonyiyibwa n'okusonyiwa abalala. Yatuyigiriza okusaba okukuumibwa okuva mu kukemebwa n'okununulibwa okuva mu bibi. Buli lw'oyogera Okusaba kwa Mukama, oba osaba okusaba Yesu yennyini kwe yatuwa.

Mu byafaayo by'Ekkanisa, oboolyawo tewali maama mwesigwa mu kusaba akulembera nga Monika. Yali maama wa Agusito, eyafuuka omu ku bayigiriza abasingira ddala obukulu Ekkanisa gye yali erina.

Naye Agusito nga tannafuuka musajja wa Katonda, yali mujeemu. Yagobereranga essanyu ery'ensi, yagobereranga abayigiriza ab'obulimba, yamenyanga omutima gwa maama we emirundi n'emirundi. Monika yamusabira okumala emyaka mingi — abamu bagamba nti eyabula okutuuka ku myaka amakumi asatu. Yamukaabira. Yamugoberera okuva mu Afirika ey'Obukiikakkono okutuuka mu Yitale. Teyakkiriza kuggwaamu maanyi. Olunaku lumu, Agusito yawulira eddoboozi ly'omwana nga ligamba, "Ddira osome, ddira osome." Yagula ebyawandiikibwa, n'asoma ekitundu okuva mu Abaruumi, n'awaayo obulamu bwe eri Kristo. Oluvannyuma yawandiika nti obulokozi bwe yabuweebwa lwa maziga ga maama we. Mwannyinaze, bw'oba osabira omwana ow'obulenzi oba ow'obuwala omujeemu, oba omwami atannamanya Mukama, toggwaamu maanyi. Monika yasaba okumala emyaka amakumi asatu. Okusaba kwo tekufa bwereere.

Ne mu biseera byaffe ffe, Okuzuukuka kw'Afirika ey'Ebuvanjuba okw'omu myaka gya 1930 n'emyaka egyaddirira kwazaalibwa mu kusaba. Ku nsozi za Rwanda, mu Uganda, mu Kenya, ebibinja ebitono eby'Abakristaayo byatandika okukuŋŋaana n'okusaba n'obunyiikivu bungi. Baayatulaganako ebibi byabwe. Baatambulira mu kitangaala. Era Omwoyo gwa Katonda ne gubakkako. Okuzuukuka ne kubuna okutuuka mu Tanzania, mu Kongo, n'okwetooloola ensi yonna. Abakazi baakola omulimu omukulu ennyo mu ntambula eno. Baasabira mu maka gaabwe, baabuulira mu butale, baatandikawo ebibinja by'obwesigwa ebikyaliwo ne leero. Omuliro gw'okuzuukuka okwo gwakka olw'abakazi n'abasajja abaali abeetegefu okusaba.

Kale oyinza otya okukuza obulamu obw'okusaba? Ka nkuwe amagezi amatono agatonotono. Ekisooka, londa ekiseera.

Tekyetaagisa kubeera kiseera kiwanvu okusooka. Eddakiika ttaano ku makya, ng'abaana tebannazuukuka, y'entandikwa ennungi. Obulamu bwo obw'okusaba nga bukula, ojja kwagala ebiseera bingi wamu ne Mukama, so si bitono.

Eky'okubiri, londa ekifo. Yesu yagamba okuyingira mu kasenge ko, kitegeeza ekifo eky'ekyama. Oboolyawo kye kakoona ka kisenge kyo, oba entebe wansi w'omuti, oba ekifo mu lusuku. Eky'okusatu, kozesa enteekateeka ennyangu.

Oyinza okutandika n'okwebaza, oluvannyuma okwatula ebibi, oluvannyuma okwegayiririra abalala, oluvannyuma ebyo bye weetaaga ggwe. Eky'okuna, saba ebyawandiikibwa. Bikkula Baibuli yo ku Zabbuli oba ku kusaba kwa Pawulo mu Abaefeso oba Abakkolosaayi obisabe eri Katonda. Eky'okutaano, kuuma olukalala lw'okusaba. Wandiika amannya g'omwami wo, abaana bo, omusumba wo, baliraanwa bo, pulezidenti wo, ababaka, n'abaabula. Sabira olukalala olwo obutayosa. Eky'omukaaga, sabanga olunaku lwonna. Ng'ofumba, ng'onaaza, ng'otambulira mu lusuku, yimusanga omutima gwo eri Mukama.

Oluusi addamu mu kaseera we tusabira. Oluusi alinda. Oluusi addamu mu ngeri ze tutasuubira. Naye bulijjo awulira. Okusaba kw'omukazi omutuukirivu kukola nnyo.

Mpa omutima gwa Kaana, eyafuka emmeeme ye mu maaso go. Mpa okukkiriza kwa Ana, eyakuuma n'alinda Masiya. Nfuula omukazi ow'okusaba, amaka gange, ekkanisa yange, eggwanga lyange, n'omulembe gwange bibone okuweebwa omukisa olw'okuba nafukamiza amaviivi gange mu maaso go. Mu linnya lyo ery'amaanyi mwe nsabira, Amiina.
fields.body_text: "Musabenga awatali kulekeraawo." Abasessalonika Abasooka 5:17 (KJV) Mu mirimu gyonna omukazi Omukristaayo gy'ayinza okukola, tewali gwa maanyi kusinga kusaba. Omukazi ng'afukamidde ayinza okukyusa ebyafaayo. Ayinza okumenya ebigo by'omulabe. Ayinza okusengejja omukono gwa Katonda okuwonya, okulokola, okugabirira, n'okukuuma. Obwakabaka bulyawo bwazimbibwa era ne buggwaawo olw'abakazi abaasaba. Amaka mangi genkabwa gaaleeteddwa eri Kristo olw'okusaba okw'ekyama era okw'obwesigwa okwa maama oba jjajja omukazi. Toteekereza n'akatono nti okusaba mulimu mutono. Baibuli etuwa ebiragiro ebitegeerekeka ku kusaba. Tuteekwa okusaba awatali kulekeraawo. Tuteekwa okusabira abalabe baffe n'abo abatuyigganya. Tuteekwa okusabira bakabaka n'abo bonna abali mu buyinza, tulyoke tube n'obulamu obw'emirembe era obuteekuteeka. Tuteekwa okusabiraganako tulyoke tuwonyezebwe. Tuteekwa okusaba mu kyama, ne Kitaffe alaba mu kyama alituwa empeera mu lwatu. Tuteekwa okusaba n'okukkiriza, awatali kubuusabuusa. Tuteekwa okusaba mu linnya lya Yesu. Era tuteekwa okusaba mu maanyi g'Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Ka nkulabise Kaana. Olugero lwe luli mu Samwiri Ow'olubereberye essuula esooka. Kaana yali afumbiddwa omusajja ayitibwa Erukaana, naye teyasobola kuzaala baana. Mu buwangwa obwo, kino kyali nsonyi nnyingi era nnaku nnyingi. Muggya we, Penina, yamusekereranga olw'ekyo. Yasaba n'obunnya bungi n'emimwa gye ne ginyeenya naye eddoboozi ne litawulikika. Eri kabona n'alowooza nti atamidde, naye teyali atamidde mwenge — yali atamidde nnaku n'okwegomba okungi Katonda amuwulire. Yeeyama ekyeyamo: Katonda bwe yandimuwadde omwana ow'obulenzi, yandimuwaddeyo eri Mukama ennaku zonna ez'obulamu bwe. Katonda yawulira Kaana. Yaba olubuto n'azaala Samwiri. Era Samwiri yakula n'afuuka omu ku bannabbi abasingira ddala obukulu mu byafaayo bya Isirayiri. Ye yafuka amafuta ku Kabaka Dawudi, omusajja eyakwatagana n'omutima gwa Katonda, gwe yava mu zzadde lye Yesu Masiya. Lowooza ku ekyo, mwannyinaze. Olulyo lwonna olwa Kabaka Dawudi, olwatuusa ku kuzaalibwa kw'Omulokozi waffe, lwava mu kusaba okwaddibwamu okw'omukazi eyakaaba. Tonyoomanga amaziga go mu maaso ga Mukama. Ne wabaawo Ana, mu Lukka essuula ey'okubiri. Yali mukazi mukadde, nnamwandu eyali amaze emyaka egisukka mu nkaaga bwe tumusanga. Ekyawandiikibwa kigamba nti teyavanga mu yeekaalu, naye yaweerezanga Katonda n'okusiiba n'okusaba emisana n'ekiro. Maliyamu ne Yusufu bwe baaleeta omwana omuto Yesu mu yeekaalu, Ana n'amulaba, n'ategeera oyo gwe yali, n'awa Katonda okwebaza. Emyaka gye egy'okusaba gyamuteekateeka okutegeera Masiya amangwago bwe yatuuka. Okusaba kutendeka amaaso go okulaba abalala bye batayinza kulaba. Mukama Yesu yennyini yatuyigiriza engeri y'okusaba. Yatuyigiriza okutandika n'okusinza — "Erinnya lyo litukuzibwe." Yatuyigiriza okusabira Katonda by'ayagala — "Obwakabaka bwo bujje, by'oyagala bikolebwe." Yatuyigiriza okusaba ebyetaago byaffe ebya buli lunaku — "Otuwe leero emmere yaffe eya buli lunaku." Yatuyigiriza okunoonya okusonyiyibwa n'okusonyiwa abalala. Yatuyigiriza okusaba okukuumibwa okuva mu kukemebwa n'okununulibwa okuva mu bibi. Buli lw'oyogera Okusaba kwa Mukama, oba osaba okusaba Yesu yennyini kwe yatuwa. Mu byafaayo by'Ekkanisa, oboolyawo tewali maama mwesigwa mu kusaba akulembera nga Monika. Yali maama wa Agusito, eyafuuka omu ku bayigiriza abasingira ddala obukulu Ekkanisa gye yali erina. Naye Agusito nga tannafuuka musajja wa Katonda, yali mujeemu. Yagobereranga essanyu ery'ensi, yagobereranga abayigiriza ab'obulimba, yamenyanga omutima gwa maama we emirundi n'emirundi. fields.title: Okukweka Ekigambo kya Katonda mu Mutima Gwo
fields.body_html:
"Ekigambo kyo nkikwese mu mutima gwange, nneme okwonoona gy'oli." Zabbuli 119:11 (KJV) Singa okusaba kwe kussa kw'omukazi Omukristaayo, ekigambo kya Katonda gwe mmere ye eya buli lunaku. Mukama waffe Yesu yagamba nti omuntu tabeera mulamu na mmere yokka, wabula na buli kigambo ekiva mu kamwa ka Katonda. Toyinza kulowooza kubeera awatali mmere okumala ennaku nnyingi — wandinafuye n'olwala. Naye abakazi Abakristaayo bameka abayita buli lunaku, buli wiiki, awatali kusoma, kuwulira, oba kufumiitiriza ku byawandiikibwa? Kyewuunyisa bwe twewulira nga tunafuye mu mwoyo, nga tutabuseeko, era nga buli kizibu kitusuula wano n'eri?

Baibuli si kitabo kya bulijjo. Kyawandiikibwa mu kiseera ekyawera emyaka nga lukumi mu bitaano, abawandiisi abantu abasukka mu amakumi ana ab'enjawulo, mu nnimi ssatu, mu bitundu by'ensi bisatu. Naye erina obubaka bumu obukulu n'Omuwandiisi omu omukulu — Omwoyo Omutukuvu owa Katonda. Buli kigambo kyayo kigasa mu kuyigiriza, mu kunenya, mu kugolola, ne mu kutendeka mu butuukirivu. Bw'osoma Baibuli, oba owulira eddoboozi lya Katonda lyennyini nga likwogera.

Okumala enkumi n'enkumi ez'emyaka, abakkiriza abasinga obungi tebaayinza kwesomera byawandiikibwa. Byakoppololwanga n'engalo, era ekitabo kya Baibuli ekimu kiyinza okuba nga kya muwendo omungi okusinga ekyo amaka gye gaafunanga mu mwaka mulamba.

Ekyuma eky'okukuba ebyapa bwe kyayiiyibwa mu Bulaaya mu myaka gya 1400, ne Baibuli bwe yatandika okuvvuunulwa mu nnimi ez'abantu aba bulijjo, kyakyusa ensi. Ne kaakano, Baibuli evvuunuddwa mu nnimi enkumi n'enkumi — mu Afrika ey'Ebuvanjuba yokka, Oluganda, Oluswayiri, Ikinyarwanda, Orunyankole, Luo, n'endala nnyingi; ne mu nsi yonna, oboolyawo n'olulimi lwo ggwe. Kino kirabo kya ngeri ki! Tokitwala nga kya bwereere. Waliwo abakazi mu bitundu ebirala eby'ensi leero abatambula essaawa nnyingi okufuna ekitabo kimu eky'ebyawandiikibwa.

Baibuli etutegeeza ku bakazi abaayagala ekigambo kya Katonda. Maliyamu, nnyina Yesu, bwe yawulira obubaka bwa malayika Gabulyeri, yayanukula n'oluyimba lwe kaakano lwe tuyita Magnificat. Bw'olusoma n'obwegendereza, ojja kulaba nti buli lunyiriri kigambo kikoppololwa oba ekyesigamiziddwa ku byawandiikibwa eby'Endagaano Enkadde. Maliyamu yali muwala muto, oboolyawo eyalina emyaka nga kkumi n'etaano oba kkumi na mukaaga, era yamanya Baibuli ye bulungi nnyo, olwo bwe yajjuzibwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu, ekigambo kya Katonda ne kimukulukutamu ng'ettendo. Ebyawandiikibwa bitutegeeza nti Maliyamu yakuuma ebintu bino byonna n'abifumiitirizaako mu mutima gwe.

Yali mukazi eyafumiitirizanga ku kigambo kya Katonda.

Omutume Pawulo yawandiikira omuyambi we omuto Timoseewo ebbaluwa, n'amujjukiza okukkiriza okwasooka okubeera mu jjajja we omukazi Loyisi ne mu nnyina Ewunike. Yagamba nti okuva mu buto Timoseewo yamanya Ebyawandiikibwa Ebitukuvu, ebiyinza okumufuula ow'amagezi okutuuka mu bulokozi olw'okukkiriza okuli mu Kristo Yesu. Ani eyayigiriza Timoseewo ebyawandiikibwa ng'akyali muto? Nnyina ne jjajja we omukazi. Tebaalindirira alyoke akule. Tebaagamba nti, "Bw'anaakula, tunaamutuma mu ssomero lya Baibuli." Baatandika okumuyigiriza ng'akyali mulenzi muto. Era ekyava mu ekyo, Timoseewo yafuuka omu ku basumba abakulu ab'Ekkanisa ey'edda era munywanyi omwagalwa ow'omutume Pawulo.

Mu kitabo ky'Ebikolwa by'Abatume, essuula ey'ekkumi n'omusanvu, abatume bajja mu kifo ekiyitibwa Beroya. Ab'e Beroya baayitibwa ab'ekitiibwa okusinga ab'e Sessaloniika kubanga baakkiriza ekigambo n'omutima ogumaliridde, ne banoonya mu byawandiikibwa buli lunaku okulaba obanga ebintu Pawulo bye yabuulira byali bwe bityo. Weetegereze — tebaakkiriza kyokka Pawulo kye yagamba olw'okuba nga yali mutume. Baakikeberera ku Baibuli. Kino kye kyokulabirako ekirungi gye tuli. Tubeera mu kiseera abantu abangi mwe bayigiririza ebintu ebiwulikika bulungi naye nga si bya mazima eri ekigambo kya Katonda. Ekisinga obukuumi ky'oyinza okukola kwe kumanya Baibuli yo bulungi nnyo, olwo omuyigiriza ow'obulimba bw'ayogera, oyinze okugamba mu mutima gwo nti, "Ekyo tekituukagana na ebyo ebyawandiikibwa bye biyigiriza."

Kaakano ka njogere mu ngeri ey'obukwakkulizo. Ofuuka otya omukazi ow'Ekigambo? Ka nkuwe empisa ennyangu mukaaga.

Ekisooka, soma Baibuli buli lunaku. Tandika n'eddakiika kkumi oba kkumi n'ettaano buli lunaku. Soma ekitabo kya Baibuli okuva ku ntandikwa okutuuka ku nkomerero. Enjiri ya Makko kifo kirungi okutandikira kubanga mpi era ejjudde ebikolwa. Oluvannyuma soma Yokaana olw'obuziba bwayo. Soma Olubereberye okutegeera entandikwa. Soma Zabbuli olw'okusaba n'ettendo. Soma Engero — essuula emu buli lunaku, ng'egeraageeganya n'olunaku olw'omwezi — olw'amagezi ag'obulamu obwa bulijjo.

Ekyokubiri, kwata ebyawandiikibwa ku mutwe. Tandika n'olunyiriri lumu buli wiiki. Luwandiike ku kapapula akatono okitwale mu nsawo yo. Lusome bw'oba ofumba, bw'oba otambula, bw'oba owummula. Ku nkomerero y'omwaka onooba okwese ennyiriri amakumi ataano mu bbiri mu mutima gwo.

Zabbuli 119:11 wagamba nti, "Ekigambo kyo nkikwese mu mutima gwange, nneme okwonoona gy'oli."

Ebyawandiikibwa ebikwatiddwa ku mutwe kya kulwanyisa eri okukemebwa. Omulabe bw'akwogerera mu kutu, oyinza okumukuba wansi n'ekitala ky'Omwoyo.

Ekyokusatu, fumiitiriza ku ebyo by'osoma. Okufumiitiriza kitegeeza okulowooza mu buziba, okwekaliriza, okukyusakyusa olunyiriri mu birowoozo byo. Buuza ebibuuzo eri ekyawandiikibwa. Kino kintegeeza ki ku Katonda? Kino kintegeeza ki ku nze kennyini? Waliwo ekisuubizo eky'okunyweza? Waliwo ekiragiro eky'okugondera? Waliwo ekibi eky'okwewala? Waliwo ekyokulabirako eky'okugoberera?

Ekyokuna, yiga Baibuli n'abakazi abalala. Mukuŋŋaane awamu — oboolyawo abamu ku mmwe mu kkanisa yammwe oba mu kitundu kyammwe — musome ekitabo kya Baibuli. Mukubaganye ebirowoozo ku ebyo bye muyize. Musabe awamu. Enkolagana ng'eno enyweza buli omu.

Ekyokutaano, tuula wansi w'okuyigiriza okulungi. Genda mu kkanisa ekkiriza Baibuli, ebyawandiikibwa mwe bibuulirwa n'obwesigwa. Wuliriza n'obwegendereza okubuulira. Wandiika ebiwandiiko bw'oba osobola okusoma n'okuwandiika. Bwe wabaawo pulogulaamu za leediyo ennungi oba ebikwatiddwa ku byuma okuva mu babuulizi abeesigwa mu kitundu kyo, bikozese n'amagezi.

Ekyomukaaga, yigiriza abalala ebyo by'oyiga. Tewali ngeri nnungi ey'okutegeera Baibuli ekusinga okugiyigiriza omuntu omulala, ne bw'oba mwana muto. Bw'onnyonnyola olunyiriri eri mutabani wo oba muwala wo, emirundi mingi ojja kusanga nti Katonda akuyigiriza mu buziba obusingako okusookera edda.

Ka mmalire essuula eno n'ennyiriri ezimu buli mukazi Omukristaayo z'asaanidde okumanya ku mutima.

Ziwandiike. Zeeyige omwaka guno. Yokaana 3:16. Abaruumi 8:28. Zabbuli 23. Engero 3:5 ne 6.

Engero 31:30. Isaaya 41:10. Abafiripi 4:6 ne 7. Abafiripi 4:13. Timoseewo owookubiri 3:16 ne 17. Abaggalatiya 5:22 ne 23. Okusaba kwa Mukama mu Matayo 6. Ekiragiro Ekikulu mu Matayo 28:19 ne 20. Bino binaaba ttaala eri ebigere byo n'omusana eri ekkubo lyo ennaku zonna ez'obulamu bwo.

Okusaba Kitaffe ali mu ggulu, nkwebaza kubanga otuwadde Ekigambo kyo ekitukuvu. Nsonyiwa olw'ebiseera bye nakiragajjaliranga. Mpa enjala ey'ebyawandiikibwa, enjala esinga enjala yange ey'emmere. Zibula amaaso gange ndyoke ndabe ebintu eby'ekitalo ebiva mu mateeka go. Kweka ekigambo kyo mu buziba bw'omutima gwange, ndyoke nneme okwonoona gy'oli.

Nfuula omukazi ayagala Ekigambo kyo, abeera ng'Ekigambo kyo bwe kigamba, era ayigiriza Ekigambo kyo omulembe oguddako. Mu linnya lya Yesu, Amiina.

Naye erina obubaka bumu obukulu n'Omuwandiisi omu omukulu — Omwoyo Omutukuvu owa Katonda. Buli kigambo kyayo kigasa mu kuyigiriza, mu kunenya, mu kugolola, ne mu kutendeka mu butuukirivu. Bw'osoma Baibuli, oba owulira eddoboozi lya Katonda lyennyini nga likwogera. Okumala enkumi n'enkumi ez'emyaka, abakkiriza abasinga obungi tebaayinza kwesomera byawandiikibwa. Byakoppololwanga n'engalo, era ekitabo kya Baibuli ekimu kiyinza okuba nga kya muwendo omungi okusinga ekyo amaka gye gaafunanga mu mwaka mulamba. Ekyuma eky'okukuba ebyapa bwe kyayiiyibwa mu Bulaaya mu myaka gya 1400, ne Baibuli bwe yatandika okuvvuunulwa mu nnimi ez'abantu aba bulijjo, kyakyusa ensi. Ne kaakano, Baibuli evvuunuddwa mu nnimi enkumi n'enkumi — mu Afrika ey'Ebuvanjuba yokka, Oluganda, Oluswayiri, Ikinyarwanda, Orunyankole, Luo, n'endala nnyingi; ne mu nsi yonna, oboolyawo n'olulimi lwo ggwe. Kino kirabo kya ngeri ki! Tokitwala nga kya bwereere. Waliwo abakazi mu bitundu ebirala eby'ensi leero abatambula essaawa nnyingi okufuna ekitabo kimu eky'ebyawandiikibwa. Baibuli etutegeeza ku bakazi abaayagala ekigambo kya Katonda. Maliyamu, nnyina Yesu, bwe yawulira obubaka bwa malayika Gabulyeri, yayanukula n'oluyimba lwe kaakano lwe tuyita Magnificat. Bw'olusoma n'obwegendereza, ojja kulaba nti buli lunyiriri kigambo kikoppololwa oba ekyesigamiziddwa ku byawandiikibwa eby'Endagaano Enkadde. Maliyamu yali muwala muto, oboolyawo eyalina emyaka nga kkumi n'etaano oba kkumi na mukaaga, era yamanya Baibuli ye bulungi nnyo, olwo bwe yajjuzibwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu, ekigambo kya Katonda ne kimukulukutamu ng'ettendo. Ebyawandiikibwa bitutegeeza nti Maliyamu yakuuma ebintu bino byonna n'abifumiitirizaako mu mutima gwe. Yali mukazi eyafumiitirizanga ku kigambo kya Katonda. Omutume Pawulo yawandiikira omuyambi we omuto Timoseewo ebbaluwa, n'amujjukiza okukkiriza okwasooka okubeera mu jjajja we omukazi Loyisi ne mu nnyina Ewunike. Yagamba nti okuva mu buto Timoseewo yamanya Ebyawandiikibwa Ebitukuvu, ebiyinza okumufuula ow'amagezi okutuuka mu bulokozi olw'okukkiriza okuli mu Kristo Yesu. Ani eyayigiriza Timoseewo ebyawandiikibwa ng'akyali muto? Nnyina ne jjajja we omukazi. Tebaalindirira alyoke akule. Tebaagamba nti, "Bw'anaakula, tunaamutuma mu ssomero lya Baibuli." Baatandika okumuyigiriza ng'akyali mulenzi muto. Era ekyava mu ekyo, Timoseewo yafuuka omu ku basumba abakulu ab'Ekkanisa ey'edda era munywanyi omwagalwa ow'omutume Pawulo. Mu kitabo ky'Ebikolwa by'Abatume, essuula ey'ekkumi n'omusanvu, abatume bajja mu kifo ekiyitibwa Beroya. Ab'e Beroya baayitibwa ab'ekitiibwa okusinga ab'e Sessaloniika kubanga baakkiriza ekigambo n'omutima ogumaliridde, ne banoonya mu byawandiikibwa buli lunaku okulaba obanga ebintu Pawulo bye yabuulira byali bwe bityo. Weetegereze — tebaakkiriza kyokka Pawulo kye yagamba olw'okuba nga yali mutume. Baakikeberera ku Baibuli. Kino kye kyokulabirako ekirungi gye tuli. Tubeera mu kiseera abantu abangi mwe bayigiririza ebintu ebiwulikika bulungi naye nga si bya mazima eri ekigambo kya Katonda. Ekisinga obukuumi ky'oyinza okukola kwe kumanya Baibuli yo bulungi nnyo, olwo omuyigiriza ow'obulimba bw'ayogera, oyinze okugamba mu mutima gwo nti, "Ekyo tekituukagana na ebyo ebyawandiikibwa bye biyigiriza." Kaakano ka njogere mu ngeri ey'obukwakkulizo. Ofuuka otya omukazi ow'Ekigambo? Ka nkuwe empisa ennyangu mukaaga. Ekisooka, soma Baibuli buli lunaku. Tandika n'eddakiika kkumi oba kkumi n'ettaano buli lunaku. Soma ekitabo kya Baibuli okuva ku ntandikwa okutuuka ku nkomerero. Enjiri ya Makko kifo kirungi okutandikira kubanga mpi era ejjudde ebikolwa. Oluvannyuma soma Yokaana olw'obuziba bwayo. Soma Olubereberye okutegeera entandikwa. Soma Zabbuli olw'okusaba n'ettendo. Soma Engero — essuula emu buli lunaku, ng'egeraageeganya n'olunaku olw'omwezi — olw'amagezi ag'obulamu obwa bulijjo. Ekyokubiri, kwata ebyawandiikibwa ku mutwe. Tandika n'olunyiriri lumu buli wiiki. Luwandiike ku kapapula akatono okitwale mu nsawo yo. Lusome bw'oba ofumba, bw'oba otambula, bw'oba owummula. Ku nkomerero y'omwaka onooba okwese ennyiriri amakumi ataano mu bbiri mu mutima gwo. Zabbuli 119:11 wagamba nti, "Ekigambo kyo nkikwese mu mutima gwange, nneme okwonoona gy'oli." Ebyawandiikibwa ebikwatiddwa ku mutwe kya kulwanyisa eri okukemebwa. Omulabe bw'akwogerera mu kutu, oyinza okumukuba wansi n'ekitala ky'Omwoyo. Ekyokusatu, fumiitiriza ku ebyo by'osoma. Okufumiitiriza kitegeeza okulowooza mu buziba, okwekaliriza, okukyusakyusa olunyiriri mu birowoozo byo. Buuza ebibuuzo eri ekyawandiikibwa. Kino kintegeeza ki ku Katonda? Kino kintegeeza ki ku nze kennyini? Waliwo ekisuubizo eky'okunyweza? Waliwo ekiragiro eky'okugondera? Waliwo ekibi eky'okwewala? Waliwo ekyokulabirako eky'okugoberera? Ekyokuna, yiga Baibuli n'abakazi abalala. Mukuŋŋaane awamu — oboolyawo abamu ku mmwe mu kkanisa yammwe oba mu kitundu kyammwe — musome ekitabo kya Baibuli. Mukubaganye ebirowoozo ku ebyo bye muyize. Musabe awamu. Enkolagana ng'eno enyweza buli omu. Ekyokutaano, tuula wansi w'okuyigiriza okulungi. Genda mu kkanisa ekkiriza Baibuli, ebyawandiikibwa mwe bibuulirwa n'obwesigwa. Wuliriza n'obwegendereza okubuulira. Wandiika ebiwandiiko bw'oba osobola okusoma n'okuwandiika. Bwe wabaawo pulogulaamu za leediyo ennungi oba ebikwatiddwa ku byuma okuva mu babuulizi abeesigwa mu kitundu kyo, bikozese n'amagezi. Ekyomukaaga, yigiriza abalala ebyo by'oyiga. Tewali ngeri nnungi ey'okutegeera Baibuli ekusinga okugiyigiriza omuntu omulala, ne bw'oba mwana muto. Bw'onnyonnyola olunyiriri eri mutabani wo oba muwala wo, emirundi mingi ojja kusanga nti Katonda akuyigiriza mu buziba obusingako okusookera edda. Ka mmalire essuula eno n'ennyiriri ezimu buli mukazi Omukristaayo z'asaanidde okumanya ku mutima. Ziwandiike. Zeeyige omwaka guno. Yokaana 3:16. Abaruumi 8:28. Zabbuli 23. Engero 3:5 ne 6. Engero 31:30. Isaaya 41:10. Abafiripi 4:6 ne 7. Abafiripi 4:13. Timoseewo owookubiri 3:16 ne 17. Abaggalatiya 5:22 ne 23. Okusaba kwa Mukama mu Matayo 6. Ekiragiro Ekikulu mu Matayo 28:19 ne 20. Bino binaaba ttaala eri ebigere byo n'omusana eri ekkubo lyo ennaku zonna ez'obulamu bwo. Okusaba Kitaffe ali mu ggulu, nkwebaza kubanga otuwadde Ekigambo kyo ekitukuvu. Nsonyiwa olw'ebiseera bye nakiragajjaliranga. Mpa enjala ey'ebyawandiikibwa, enjala esinga enjala yange ey'emmere. Zibula amaaso gange ndyoke ndabe ebintu eby'ekitalo ebiva mu mateeka go. Kweka ekigambo kyo mu buziba bw'omutima gwange, ndyoke nneme okwonoona gy'oli. Nfuula omukazi ayagala Ekigambo kyo, abeera ng'Ekigambo kyo bwe kigamba, era ayigiriza Ekigambo kyo omulembe oguddako. Mu linnya lya Yesu, Amiina.

fields.title: Okwagala n'Okussaamu Bba Wo Ekitiibwa
fields.body_html:
"Kyokka buli omu ku mmwe ayagalenga mukazi we nga bwe yeeyagala yekka; ne mukazi alabenga ng'assaamu bba we ekitiibwa." Abaefeso 5:33 (KJV) Obufumbo kyali kirowoozo kya Katonda. Ekibi nga tekinnajja, n'ennaku yonna nga tennabaawo mu nsi, Katonda yagamba nti si kirungi omusajja okubeera yekka, n'amukolera omukazi okuba omubeezi n'omunywanyi we.

Embaga y'obufumbo eyasooka yonna yakolebwa Katonda yennyini mu Nnimiro ya Adeni. Kino kitutegeeza ekintu eky'amaanyi ennyo. Obufumbo si kintu kya kuyiiya kwa muntu. Kye ndagaano entukuvu Katonda gye yateekateeka, era kyoleka ekimu ku bujja bwe — okwagala okuli wakati wa Kristo n'Ekkanisa ye.

Mu biseera byaffe, obufumbo bulumbibwa nnyo. Abamu bagamba nti bwa dda ennyo. Abamu bagamba nti kkomera eri abakazi. Abamu bagamba nti busaanidde okukomekkerezebwa amangu nga bwe bufuuka obuzibu. Abalala babutwala nga ndagaano eyinza okumenyebwa buli mukwano gw'abafumbo omu lw'atakkiriziddwa. Naye, mwannyinaze, Ebyawandiikibwa bituwa ekifaananyi eky'enjawulo ennyo. Obufumbo bwateekebwawo okumala obulamu bwonna. Bwateekebwawo okuba ekifo eky'okwagala, eky'ekitiibwa, eky'obwannywani, eky'obwesigwa, n'eky'okubala ebibala. Ne mu bufumbo, Katonda awadde omukazi Omukristaayo okuyitibwa okulungi era okw'amaanyi.

Omutume Pawulo awandiika mu Abaefeso essuula ey'okutaano nti abakazi bagwanidde okugondera babbaabwe nga bwe bagondera Mukama, era nti abasajja bagwanidde okwagala bakazi baabwe nga Kristo bwe yayagala Ekkanisa ne yeewaayo ku lwayo. Ebiragiro bino ebibiri bigenda wamu. Bba si kabaka afuga n'obukambwe. Ayitibwa okwagala okw'okwewaayo. Omukazi si muddu. Ayitibwa okuwagira bba we mu bukulembeze bwe n'okwagala era n'okugonza. Bwe kanaaba nti bba n'omukazi bombi bagondera Mukama mu kuyitibwa kwabwe okw'enjawulo, obufumbo bufuuka ekifaananyi ky'Enjiri yennyini.

Peetero awandiika ekintu ekirungi mu Peetero ow'olubereberye essuula ey'okusatu. Ayogera eri abakazi, era akozesa Saala ng'ekyokulabirako. Saala yayita Ibulayimu mukama we, era yamugondera. Peetero agamba abakazi Abakristaayo nti obulungi bwabwe tebusaanidde kuva mu nviiri ennange, oba mu bya zaabu eby'okwewunda, oba mu ngoye ennungi, wabula mu muntu ow'omunda ali mu mutima — omwoyo omuwombeefu era omuteefu — ogw'omuwendo omungi mu maaso ga Katonda. Kino tekitegeeza nti omukazi Omukristaayo tateekwa kwogera oba kubeera na birowoozo bibye ye.

Saala yayogera bye yalowooza eri Ibulayimu. Abigayiri yayogera bye yalowooza eri Dawudi. Omukazi ow'omu Engero 31 ayasamya akamwa ke n'amagezi. Peetero ky'ategeeza kiri nti omukazi Omukristaayo si wa luyoogaano, si wa nnyombo, si wa lulimi luyitirivu, era si w'okulwanirira ekkubo lye buli kiseera. Yeetwala mu kitiibwa. Omwoyo gwe muteefu. Ne babbaabwe abatakkiriza bayinza okuwangulwa olw'empisa z'abakazi baabwe awatali kigambo.

Lowooza ku Pulisikira mu kitabo ky'Ebikolwa by'Abatume. Yali afumbiddwa Akula, era baakoleranga awamu ng'abakozi b'eweema. Baatambulanga ne Pawulo. Baaggulirawo ekkanisa mu maka gaabwe. Bwe baawulira omubuulizi omukugu Apolo, eyali tannategeera bulungi Njiri, baamutwala ku bbali bombi ne bamunnyonnyola ekkubo lya Katonda mu bujjuvu obusingako. Pulisikira ayogerwako ng'ali wamu ne bba we buli kiseera — oluusi n'erinnya lye ye lisooka okulambikibwa — era baaweereza Mukama awamu ng'ekibiina kimu. Kino kifaananyi kirungi eky'obufumbo obw'Ekikristaayo. Bba n'omukazi, nga bakolera awamu ku lw'Obwakabaka.

Oba lowooza ku Luusi. Bowaazi bwe yamulaba, teyasooka kumwagala lwa bulungi bwe. Yamwagala olw'empisa ze. Ekisa kye eri Nawomi, obunyiikivu bwe mu nnimiro, n'okwagala kwe okugoberera Katonda wa Isirayiri — ebintu bino byamwawula. Bowaazi yamugamba nti ekibuga kyonna kyamanya nti mukazi wa mpisa nnungi. Nga tannafumbirwa, Luusi yali amaze okubeera ng'omukazi atya Katonda.

Ka njogere mu ngeri ey'obukozi, kubanga okumanya awatali kukikola tekuyamba muntu yenna. Oyinza otya okwagala n'okussaamu bba wo ekitiibwa mu wiiki eno?

Mwogereko bulungi. Toyingira mu bakazi ab'oku katale oba ab'oku luzzi abavuma babbaabwe.

Bw'aba tali waawo, ebigambo byo ebimukwatako bimuzimbe. Naddala abaana bawuliriza. Toyonoona kitaabwe mu maaso gaabwe. Bw'aba n'ensobi — era abasajja bonna balina ensobi, nga n'abakazi bonna bwe bali — ensobi ezo zitwale eri Katonda mu kusaba, so si eri ab'olugambo ab'omu kyalo.

Mumuwulirize. Bw'akomawo eka ng'akooye okuva ku mulimu, tomujjuza mangu buli kizibu abaana kye baakoze ku lunaku olwo. Muleke atuule. Mumuleetere ekikombe kya caayi. Mubuuze ku lunaku lwe.

Abasajja bangi baagala nnyo omukazi anaabawuliriza mu butuufu.

Weerabirire ggwe n'amaka go. Beera omuyonjo era ow'ensa. Kuuma amaka go nga gali mu ntegeka. Bba asanyukira okukomawo eka ye bba asigala eka. Kino tekitegeeza nti oteekwa kuba atuukiridde — tewali n'omu atuukiridde. Kitegeeza nti okola omulimu gwo okufuula amaka go ekifo eky'emirembe era eky'okwaniriza.

Mubeere omwesigwa mu mubiri ne mu mutima. Toboneka na basajja balala. Togeraageranya bba wo na basajja balala. Tokkiriza birowoozo bya kwerowoozaako ebiva mu ffirimu oba mu bitabo eby'olugero kukuwangula. Kuuma omutima gwo, kubanga okuva mu gwo mwe zisibuka ensulo z'obulamu.

Mumusabire buli lunaku. Sabira omulimu gwe, obulamu bwe, okutambula kwe okw'omwoyo, okusalawo kwe, n'okukemebwa kwe. Bba amusabirwa musajja aweereddwa omukisa, ne bw'aba nga tamanyi nsonga lwaki ebintu bimugendera bulungi.

Kaakati ka njogere ku mbeera enzibu. Singa bba wo aba nga tannaba Mukristaayo? Singa aba mukambwe? Singa anywa omwenge? Singa taba mwesigwa? Singa akukuba? Ka njogere bulungi ku bintu ebiwerako. Ekisooka, mu Peetero ow'olubereberye essuula ey'okusatu, Katonda ayogera butereevu eri abakazi abalina babbaabwe abatakkiriza. Agamba nti bayinza okuwangulwa awatali kigambo olw'empisa z'abakazi baabwe. Okusaba kwo, ekisa kyo, okugumiikiriza kwo, n'empisa zo ez'okutya Katonda — bino bya maanyi. Toleka kusaba. Toleka kulaga Kristo. Eky'okubiri, okussaamu bba wo ekitiibwa tekitegeeza kumuleka akuzikirize ggwe oba abaana bo. Bwe wabaawo akabi ak'omubiri, nsaba onoonye obuyambi bw'omusumba wo, obw'ekkanisa yo, obw'ab'omu maka abeesigwa, oba obw'ab'obuyinza abatuufu. Katonda takusaba kusigala mu mbeera eteeka obulamu bwo mu kabi. Eky'okusatu, tobonaabona mu kasirise bw'oba weetaaga obuyambi. Noonya omukazi Omukristaayo omukulu mu kkanisa yo ayinza okutambula naawe n'okusaba naawe. Toli bw'omu.

Ka mmalirize n'omukazi ava mu byafaayo by'ekkanisa. Katerina von Bora yali sisita eyava mu kkomera ly'abasisita n'afumbirwa Omuzza-buggya omukulu Marituni Luuseri. Yaddukanya amaka gaabwe amanene, n'akuza abaana baabwe, n'asembeza abagenyi, n'asogola omwenge okufuna ensimbi, era n'awagira omulimu gwa bba omunene ogw'okuvvuunula n'okuyigiriza Bayibuli. Luuseri yamuyita "emmunyeenye ye ey'oku makya" ne "Mukama we Keeti" — erinnya ery'okuzannyisa eryalaga ekitiibwa kye ekinene gye yali. Obufumbo bwabwe bwafuuka ekyokulabirako ky'obulamu bw'amaka Obukristaayo mu nsi ya Baprotesitanti okumala emyaka mingi egyaddirira. Oyinza obutavvuunulayo Bayibuli, naye engeri gy'oyagala era gy'ossaamu bba wo ekitiibwa eyinza okuba obujulizi obumala emirembe n'emirembe.

Okusaba Ayi Mukama wange, nkwebaza olw'ekirabo ky'obufumbo, kye wateekateeka okuva ku lubereberye.

Bwe mba nga mfumbiddwa, nsabira bba wange leero. Muwe omukisa, mukuume, mumusembeze okumpi naawe. Nnyamba okumwagala n'okwagala okwoleka okwagala kwo eri Ekkanisa. Nnyamba okumussaamu ekitiibwa, okumuzimba, n'okumusabira n'obwesigwa. Mpa omwoyo omuwombeefu era omuteefu ogw'omuwendo omungi mu maaso go. Awo obufumbo bwaffe we buzibuwalira, tuwe ekisa okubukolerako ffembi. Awali obukyayi, oleete okusonyiwa. Awali enjawulo, oleete okusembera. Fuula amaka gaffe ekifo gy'oweerwa ekitiibwa, era abaana baffe gye balabira obulungi bw'obufumbo Obukristaayo. Mu linnya lya Yesu, Amiina.
