Kino kifaananyi kirungi eky'obufumbo obw'Ekikristaayo. Bba n'omukazi, nga bakolera awamu ku lw'Obwakabaka. Oba lowooza ku Luusi. Bowaazi bwe yamulaba, teyasooka kumwagala lwa bulungi bwe. Yamwagala olw'empisa ze. Ekisa kye eri Nawomi, obunyiikivu bwe mu nnimiro, n'okwagala kwe okugoberera Katonda wa Isirayiri — ebintu bino byamwawula. Bowaazi yamugamba nti ekibuga kyonna kyamanya nti mukazi wa mpisa nnungi. Nga tannafumbirwa, Luusi yali amaze okubeera ng'omukazi atya Katonda. Ka njogere mu ngeri ey'obukozi, kubanga okumanya awatali kukikola tekuyamba muntu yenna. Oyinza otya okwagala n'okussaamu bba wo ekitiibwa mu wiiki eno? Mwogereko bulungi. Toyingira mu bakazi ab'oku katale oba ab'oku luzzi abavuma babbaabwe. Bw'aba tali waawo, ebigambo byo ebimukwatako bimuzimbe. Naddala abaana bawuliriza. Toyonoona kitaabwe mu maaso gaabwe. Bw'aba n'ensobi — era abasajja bonna balina ensobi, nga n'abakazi bonna bwe bali — ensobi ezo zitwale eri Katonda mu kusaba, so si eri ab'olugambo ab'omu kyalo. Mumuwulirize. Bw'akomawo eka ng'akooye okuva ku mulimu, tomujjuza mangu buli kizibu abaana kye baakoze ku lunaku olwo. Muleke atuule. Mumuleetere ekikombe kya caayi. Mubuuze ku lunaku lwe. Abasajja bangi baagala nnyo omukazi anaabawuliriza mu butuufu. Weerabirire ggwe n'amaka go. Beera omuyonjo era ow'ensa. Kuuma amaka go nga gali mu ntegeka. Bba asanyukira okukomawo eka ye bba asigala eka. Kino tekitegeeza nti oteekwa kuba atuukiridde — tewali n'omu atuukiridde. Kitegeeza nti okola omulimu gwo okufuula amaka go ekifo eky'emirembe era eky'okwaniriza. Mubeere omwesigwa mu mubiri ne mu mutima. Toboneka na basajja balala. Togeraageranya bba wo na basajja balala. Tokkiriza birowoozo bya kwerowoozaako ebiva mu ffirimu oba mu bitabo eby'olugero kukuwangula. Kuuma omutima gwo, kubanga okuva mu gwo mwe zisibuka ensulo z'obulamu. Mumusabire buli lunaku. Sabira omulimu gwe, obulamu bwe, okutambula kwe okw'omwoyo, okusalawo kwe, n'okukemebwa kwe. Bba amusabirwa musajja aweereddwa omukisa, ne bw'aba nga tamanyi nsonga lwaki ebintu bimugendera bulungi. Kaakati ka njogere ku mbeera enzibu. Singa bba wo aba nga tannaba Mukristaayo? Singa aba mukambwe? Singa anywa omwenge? Singa taba mwesigwa? Singa akukuba? Ka njogere bulungi ku bintu ebiwerako. Ekisooka, mu Peetero ow'olubereberye essuula ey'okusatu, Katonda ayogera butereevu eri abakazi abalina babbaabwe abatakkiriza. Agamba nti bayinza okuwangulwa awatali kigambo olw'empisa z'abakazi baabwe. Okusaba kwo, ekisa kyo, okugumiikiriza kwo, n'empisa zo ez'okutya Katonda — bino bya maanyi. Toleka kusaba. Toleka kulaga Kristo. Eky'okubiri, okussaamu bba wo ekitiibwa tekitegeeza kumuleka akuzikirize ggwe oba abaana bo. Bwe wabaawo akabi ak'omubiri, nsaba onoonye obuyambi bw'omusumba wo, obw'ekkanisa yo, obw'ab'omu maka abeesigwa, oba obw'ab'obuyinza abatuufu. Katonda takusaba kusigala mu mbeera eteeka obulamu bwo mu kabi. Eky'okusatu, tobonaabona mu kasirise bw'oba weetaaga obuyambi. Noonya omukazi Omukristaayo omukulu mu kkanisa yo ayinza okutambula naawe n'okusaba naawe. Toli bw'omu. Ka mmalirize n'omukazi ava mu byafaayo by'ekkanisa. Katerina von Bora yali sisita eyava mu kkomera ly'abasisita n'afumbirwa Omuzza-buggya omukulu Marituni Luuseri. Yaddukanya amaka gaabwe amanene, n'akuza abaana baabwe, n'asembeza abagenyi, n'asogola omwenge okufuna ensimbi, era n'awagira omulimu gwa bba omunene ogw'okuvvuunula n'okuyigiriza Bayibuli. Luuseri yamuyita "emmunyeenye ye ey'oku makya" ne "Mukama we Keeti" — erinnya ery'okuzannyisa eryalaga ekitiibwa kye ekinene gye yali. Obufumbo bwabwe bwafuuka ekyokulabirako ky'obulamu bw'amaka Obukristaayo mu nsi ya Baprotesitanti okumala emyaka mingi egyaddirira. Oyinza obutavvuunulayo Bayibuli, naye engeri gy'oyagala era gy'ossaamu bba wo ekitiibwa eyinza okuba obujulizi obumala emirembe n'emirembe. Okusaba Ayi Mukama wange, nkwebaza olw'ekirabo ky'obufumbo, kye wateekateeka okuva ku lubereberye. Bwe mba nga mfumbiddwa, nsabira bba wange leero. Muwe omukisa, mukuume, mumusembeze okumpi naawe. Nnyamba okumwagala n'okwagala okwoleka okwagala kwo eri Ekkanisa. Nnyamba okumussaamu ekitiibwa, okumuzimba, n'okumusabira n'obwesigwa. Mpa omwoyo omuwombeefu era omuteefu ogw'omuwendo omungi mu maaso go. Awo obufumbo bwaffe we buzibuwalira, tuwe ekisa okubukolerako ffembi. Awali obukyayi, oleete okusonyiwa. Awali enjawulo, oleete okusembera. Fuula amaka gaffe ekifo gy'oweerwa ekitiibwa, era abaana baffe gye balabira obulungi bw'obufumbo Obukristaayo. Mu linnya lya Yesu, Amiina.

fields.title: Okukulaakulana mu Buwuulu
fields.body_html:
"Kitaawe w'abatalina ba kitaabwe, era omulamuzi wa bannamwandu, ye Katonda mu kifo kye ekitukuvu. Katonda atuuza abali bokka mu maka." Zabbuli 68:5-6 (KJV) Mu ssuula eyayita twalowooza ku kuyitibwa kw'omukyala Omukristaayo. Naye tetusaanidde kukyusa lupapula nga tetusoose kwogera ku baganda baffe abakazi abatafumbiddwa. Si buli mukazi ayitibwa okuba omukyala. Abamu ku mmwe abasoma kino muli bawuulu era musuubira okufumbirwa lumu olunaku. Abalala muli mu kiseera eky'okulinda, nga temumanyi Mukama ky'anaakola. Abalala mwafiirwa ba bbaabwe ne musigala bokka oluvannyuma lw'emyaka mingi egy'obufumbo. Abalala mwagattululwa oba ne mulekebwa awatali kyammusobezza. Ate abamu ku mmwe muyinza okuwulira nga Katonda abayita okusigala nga temufumbiddwa olw'obwakabaka bwe. Embeera yo yonna gy'eri, essuula eno ya ggwe. Toli muwala wa Katonda wa wansi olw'okuba tofumbiddwa. Oyagalibwa mu bujjuvu, oyitiddwa mu bujjuvu, era osobola mu bujjuvu okuleetera Kristo ekitiibwa ekinene.

Ka njogere lwatu ku kunyigirizibwa abakazi abawuulu abangi kwe basanga — okunyigirizibwa okuwulirwa ennyo mu Buvanjuba bwa Afirika ne mu buwangwa obungi mu nsi yonna. Okuva mu buto, wabuuliddwa nti omuwendo gw'omukazi gupimibwa ku bufumbo. Ab'oluganda bakubuuza lw'olireeta omuntu eka. Baliraanwa beebuuza lwaki okyali wekka. Abamu batemya nti waliwo ekitali kituufu ku ggwe, oba oboolyawo nga wakolimirwa. Ab'omu maka bayinza okugezaako okukuwasiza mu bufumbo b'otoyagala. Okunyigirizibwa okufumbirwa — ne bwe kiba okufumbirwa atakkiriza oba omusajja ow'empisa embi olw'okufuna bbaawo bwakabaawo — kiyinza okuwulikika ng'ekikuziyiza okussa omukka. Muganda wange, wuliriza Ebyawandiikibwa bye bigamba. Obubadde bwo tebuli mu kuba omusajja yakulonda oba nedda. Obubadde bwo buli mu nsonga nti Kabaka w'Eggulu yakulonda. Yakwagala ng'ensi tennatondebwa. Yakufiirira ku musaalaba. Abeera mu ggwe olw'Omwoyo we. Tewali bufumbo bwa ku nsi obuyinza okwongera ku ekyo, era tewali buwuulu bwa ku nsi obuyinza okukiggyawo.

Lowooza ku Mukama waffe Yesu yennyini. Yatambulira ku nsi eno emyaka amakumi asatu mu esatu, era teyawasa mukazi. Yali omuntu asinga okuba omulamu mu bujjuvu eyali abaddewo. Yali asinga okwagala, asinga essanyu, asinga okuba n'ekigendererwa. Omutima gwe tegwali mugabanye. Obulamu bwe tebwali butono olw'okuba teyafumbirwa. Mu butuufu, bwali bungi n'okusingawo — kubanga yali wa ddembe okwewaayo yekka mu bujjuvu eri omulimu Kitaawe gwe yamutuma okukola. Obanga obuwuulu bwali bulungi eri Mukama waffe, kale bulungi eri bawala be.

Omutume Pawulo, mu Abakkolinso ow'olubereberye essuula ey'omusanvu, awandiika bijjuvu ku buwuulu n'obufumbo. Agamba lwatu nti omukazi atafumbiddwa afaayo ku by'a Mukama, alyoke abeere omutukuvu mu mubiri ne mu mwoyo. Asobola okuweereza Mukama awatali kusamaawalira. Pawulo tayigiriza nti obufumbo bubi — amaze okugamba nti obufumbo bwa kitiibwa. Ky'agamba kiri nti obuwuulu kirabo ekirina emikisa gyakyo egy'enjawulo. Omukazi Omukristaayo atafumbiddwa alina obudde, amaanyi, n'okussa omwoyo ku kimu, ebintu omukazi eyafumbirwa emirundi mingi by'atalina. Asobola okusaba okumala ebbanga eddene.

Asobola okuweereza mu buziba obungi. Asobola okugenda omukazi eyafumbirwa gy'atasobola kugenda mangu. Asobola okwewaayo, awatali kwegabanya, eri omulimu gwa Mukama we.

Tunuulira abakazi ab'omu Byawandiikibwa abaweereza Katonda n'amaanyi nga tebafumbiddwa. Ana nnabbi omukazi, gwe twasisinkana emabega, yafiirwa bba ng'awezezza emyaka musanvu gyokka egy'obufumbo. Yandiyise emyaka gye egyasigalawo mu bukyayi, ng'ayagala okumanya ekyandibaddewo. Mu kifo ky'ekyo, yeewaayo eri Mukama. Yamala emyaka egisukka mu nkaaga mu Yeekaalu, ng'asiiba era ng'asaba emisana n'ekiro, era yasasulwa nga ye omu ku basooka okutegeera Masiya omwana omuwere. Obuwuulu bwe tebwafiirwa bwereere. Bwe bwali ettaka lyennyini omwakulira obuweereza bwe obunene obw'okusaba.

Malyamu ow'e Besaniya, mwannyina Maliza ne Laazaalo, tewali we kyogerwa nti yafumbirwa. Ajjukirwa olw'okutuula ku bigere bya Yesu ng'anywa okuyigiriza kwe. Ajjukirwa olw'okusiiga Yesu amafuta ag'omuwendo omungi ng'atannafa. Okwewaayo kwe okutali kwa kwegabanya eri Kristo kwali kulungi nnyo, Yesu yennyini n'agamba nti ekikolwa kye eky'okwagala kinaabuulirwanga buli wonna enjiri gy'ebuulirwa, okutuuka ku nkomerero y'omulembe.

Malyamu Magadaleene, Yesu gwe yagoba dayimoni musanvu, yamugoberera mu ntambula ze, yawagira obuweereza bwe okuva mu bintu bye ye, yayimirira ku ntobo y'omusaalaba abasajja abasinga bwe baali baddukidde, era ye yasooka okulaba Mukama azuukidde ku makya g'okuzuukira. Tewali kya mu Byawandiikibwa ekiraga nti yali afumbiddwa. Obulamu bwe bwonna yabuwaayo eri Omulokozi we.

Ludiya ow'e Firipi yali n'akatale ke ak'okutunda engoye eza ffulungu. Tewali bba ayogerwako. Yakulembera ab'omu maka ge mu kubatizibwa oluvannyuma lw'okukyuka kwe. Yasembeza ekkanisa esooka mu Bulaaya mu maka ge.

Ka abe nga yafiirwa bba oba nga teyali afumbiddwa n'akatono, yakozesa eddembe lye, ebintu bye, n'amaka ge olw'Obwakabaka bwa Katonda.

Doluka ow'e Yopa yatungira bannamwandu engoye. Bawala bana aba Firipo omubuulizi w'enjiri, embeerera, baawa obunnabbi mu maanyi g'Omwoyo. Miryamu yakulembera abakazi ba Isirayeri mu luyimba oluvannyuma lw'okusomoka Ennyanja Emyufu.

Emirundi n'emirundi, Ebyawandiikibwa biwa ekitiibwa ekyo abakazi abaali batafumbiddwa kye baawaayo.

Ebyafaayo by'Ekkanisa bijjudde abakazi abawuulu abaabala ebibala eby'ekitalo. Amy Carmichael yava mu Bukiika kkono bwa Ayalandi n'agenda mu Buyindi mu 1895 era teyafumbirwa. Yatandika Dohnavur Fellowship, ekiddukiro ky'abawala abaali bawalirizibwa okuba abamalaaya ab'omu masabo. Yataasa abaana enkumi, yawandiika ebitabo ebisukka mu amakumi asatu, era yaweereza mu Buyindi emyaka amakumi ataano mu etaano awatali kuddayo waka n'omulundi n'ogumu. Mary Slessor ow'e Sukoti, gwe twasisinkana emabega, yayogezebwako emirundi ebiri okufumbirwa naye n'asigala nga tafumbiddwa olw'enjiri. Yatwala abaana enfuuzi mwenda, yamalawo okutta abaana abalongo mu bantu be yaweerezanga mu Bugwanjuba bwa Afirika, era yaggulawo ekkubo ly'enjiri mu bitundu omutaali mubuulizi n'omu eyali agezezaako okuyingira. Gladys Aylward yatambulira ku nsozi za Cayina ng'akulembera abaana enfuuzi kikumi okutuuka mu bukuumi mu kiseera Abayapaani lwe baali balumba. Helen Roseveare yaweereza ng'omubuulizi w'obusawo omuwuulu mu Kongo, yagumira okubonaabona okunene, era yasimba amalwaliro n'amakanisa agakyaliwo n'okutuusa leero. Corrie ten Boom, oluvannyuma lw'okukweka Abayudaaya okuva ku Banazi n'awonawo mu kkambi ery'okusibirwamu, yamala obulamu bwe obwasigalawo ng'abuulira ensi nti tewali bunnya buwanvu nnyo okwagala kwa Katonda ne kutasinga buziba. Buli omu ku bakazi bano yali muwuulu. Buli omu ku bo yakyusa ensi.

Kaakati wuliriza amazima gano amalungi, era ka gakkakkane wansi mu mutima gwo. Tewali Mukristaayo ali yekka mu butuufu.

Wazaalibwa omulundi ogwokubiri mu maka ga Katonda. Omutume Pawulo awandiika mu Abaefeso nti tetukyali bagwira na batambuze, wabula tuli bantu b'ekibuga awamu n'abatukuvu era ab'omu nnyumba ya Katonda. Zabbuli ey'amakumi mukaaga mu munaana egamba nti Katonda atuuza abali bokka mu maka. Yesu bwe yabuulirwa nti nnyina ne baganda be baali ebweru nga bamunoonya, yatunuulira abayigirizwa be n'agamba nti buli akola Katonda by'ayagala oyo ye muganda we ne mwannyina ne nnyina. Ekkanisa ye maka go. Abakkiriza abakulu bafuuka ba maama bo ne ba kitaawo mu kukkiriza. Abakkiriza abato bafuuka batabani bo ne bawala bo ab'omwoyo. Bannaabwe abakkiriza ab'emyaka gyo bafuuka baganda bo ne bannyoko mu Kristo. Olina amaka amanene era ag'omuwendo okusinga amaka gonna ag'omusaayi ge gasobola okubaawo.

Kino si ndowooza nnungi buwoomu. Bwe butuufu obw'omu bulamu obuteekwa okubeeramu mu kkanisa ey'omu kitundu. Bw'oba omukazi omuwuulu, teweekweka waka. Jjangu mu kussa kimu. Weeleke omanyibwe. Noonya omukazi omukulu asobola okukulabirira nga maama. Noonya abakazi abato b'osobola okuzzaamu amaanyi. Lya mu maka g'ab'amaka, era yita ab'amaka mu maka go. Kwata Ssekukkulu ne Paska n'abatukuvu bw'oba tolina ba luganda okumpi. Nakuwala mu mikono gyabwe ennaku bw'ejja. Sanyukira awamu nabo mu ssanyu lyabwe. Kino kye omubiri gwa Kristo kye guliko.

Ka njogere mu ngeri ey'obukugu kaakati. Bw'oba omuwuulu mu kiseera kino, oba kaakati oba obulamu bwo bwonna, olina okubeera otya?

Ekisooka, ssa Katonda mu maaso n'omutima ogutali mugabanye. Kino ky'ekiseera kyo eky'enjawulo eky'omukisa. Saba okusingawo.

Soma okusingawo. Siiba oluusi. Muwulirize. Mukkirize abeere okwagala kwo okusooka era okusinga obuziba. Omukazi omutima gwe guteeredde ddala ku Mukama tayinza kunyeenyezebwa nkulungizo z'ensi. Guno gwe musingi gwa buli kimu ekirala.

Eky'okubiri, kkiriza amaka g'ekkanisa. Teweeyawula. Tosigala waka ku Ssande olw'okuwulira ng'otagerageranyizibwa ng'omukazi omu yekka atafumbiddwa mu lunyiriri lwo. Tobuuka okussa kimu okw'abakazi olw'okulabika ng'okujjudde bakyala ne bamaama. Jjangu. Weereza. Yagala ab'amaka mu kkanisa yo. Saba bannyoko abakulu ab'omutima ogutya Katonda batambule naawe. Omubiri gwa Kristo gube maka go, si mu linnya lyokka wabula mu bikolwa bya buli lunaku.

Eky'okusatu, weereza n'omutima gwo gwonna. Olina obudde abakazi abafumbiddwa emirundi mingi bwe batalina. Olina amaanyi ag'okuwaayo. Lowooza ku buweereza obw'ebweru. Lowooza ku kuyigiriza. Lowooza ku kutandika obuweereza eri bannamwandu, oba enfuuzi, oba abawala abavubuka, oba abakazi ab'omu kkomera. Lowooza ku kugenda abalala gye batasobola kugenda mangu.

Obwakabaka bwa Katonda bulina bulijjo okukulaakulanyizibwa mu kitundu ekinene abakazi abawuulu abaali n'eddembe ery'okwewaayo mu bujjuvu. Wayinza okubaawo omulimu Katonda gw'akutegekedde omuntu omulala gw'atasobola kukola.

Eky'okuna, kola nnyo era noonya obulungi obw'ekitalo. Toteeka bulamu bwo mu kutuula ng'olinda bufumbo. Noonya okuyiga kwo. Kulaakulana mu mulimu gwo. Tandika bizinensi. Simba olusuku. Gula ettaka. Yiga obukugu. Wandiika ekitabo. Tereka ssente zo n'amagezi. Ba omukazi owa Engero 31 mu kiseera ky'obulamu ky'olimu. Kumpi buli kitundu ekya essuula eyo ennungi kikwata ku mukazi omuwuulu nga bwe kikwata ku eyafumbirwa. Omukazi omuwuulu omukozi era atya Katonda bujulizi bwa maanyi mu mulembe ogw'obugayaavu n'okwemulugunya.

Eky'okutaano, kuuma omutima gwo n'omubiri gwo. Obulongoofu bukulu nnyo. Toweeyawo eri omusajja atannaakwewaayo mu maaso ga Katonda ne mu maaso g'Ekkanisa. Togendera n'abatakkiriza, ne bwe baba nga ba kisa oba abalabika obulungi — tosobola kuzimba maka Gakristaayo ku musingi ogutali gwa Kikristaayo. Tokkiriza bulimba nti obufumbo obubi businga obutafumbirwa. Tebwenkanankana. Obuwuulu obutya Katonda businga emirundi lukumi obufumbo obutatya Katonda. Linda ekisinga obulungi ekya Katonda. Bw'atalireeta bufumbo, kale ky'anaakuleetera mu kifo kyakyo kinaaba kirungi kyenkanyi, kubanga Kitaawe omulungi.

Eky'omukaaga, kuza okumatira. Okumatira si kuggwaamu ssuubi. Si kuleka bufumbo oba okwefuula nti tobwagala. Bwe mirembe emiziba egy'okwesiga nti Katonda mulungi era enteekateeka ye ku bulamu bwo nnungi. Pawulo yawandiika ng'ali mu kkomera ery'e Ruumi nti yali ayize, mu mbeera yonna mwe yabeeranga, okumatira. Okuyiga okwo lugendo. Kujja okuyita mu kusaba, mu Byawandiikibwa, mu mulimu omuggavu ogw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Saba Katonda akuyigirize ekisa kino.

Ekigambo eri abo abaafiirwa ba bbaabwe. Katonda alaba ennaku yo. Ali kumpi n'abalina emitima egimenyeka.

Isaaya essuula ey'amakumi ataano mu ena egamba nti Omutonzi wo ye bba wo — Mukama w'eggye lye linnya lye. Talikuleka. Zuula okusanyusibwa mu ye, era zuula amaka go mu Kkanisa. Abakazi bangi ku abasinga amaanyi mu Byawandiikibwa ne mu byafaayo baali bannamwandu. Emyaka gyo egisinga obulungi egy'obuweereza giyinza okuba gikyali mu maaso.

Ekigambo eri abo abaagattululwa oba abaalekebwa. Toli bintu byonoonese. Katonda azaawulula ebintu byonna asobola okukuzza obuggya. Ebyayita byonna bye biri, omusaayi gwa Yesu gukufuula omulongoofu era omuggya. Toleka nsonyi kukuziyiza kukwatanwa n'abakkiriza. Jjangu. Weereza. Yagala. Oli waabwe.

Muganda wange, oba ofumbiddwa oba omuwuulu, oba nnamwandu oba olinda, oyagalibwa. Mukama takwerabidde. Awandiika olugero lwo, era lulungi, wadde obulungi obujjuvu bulirabika mu bwomu bwokka. Mwesige mu kiseera kino eky'obulamu bwo. Tokifiirikiriza ng'olinda ekiseera ekirala okutandika. Mulisa awo Katonda w'akusimbye. Weereza awo Katonda w'akuteeka. Yagala oyo Katonda gw'atadde mu maaso go. Ensi erimanya nti mwenyini, mu kitundu, olw'essanyu eriri ku maaso g'omukazi Omukristaayo omuwuulu eyazuula byonna bye mu ye.

Okusaba Kitaffe ali mu ggulu, nkwebaza olw'okuba obubadde bwange tebuli mu kufumbirwa, wabula mu nsonga nti ndi wuwo. Weebale okunfuula omuwala wo n'okunteeka mu maka go amanene, Ekkanisa. Bwe mba omuwuulu mu kiseera kino, nnyamba nkozese ekiseera kino olw'ekitiibwa kyo.

Mpa omutima ogutali mugabanye. Nfuula omukazi ow'okusaba, ow'okuweereza, n'ow'ekigendererwa.

Nkuuma nneme okwolumbwa obwesudde n'okumatira ku ekitono okusinga ekisinga obulungi ekikyo. Neetoolooze baganda bange ne bannyinaze abanjagala nga ab'omu maka go. Bw'olimpita mu bufumbo lumu olunaku, nteekateeka era omuteekateeke naye. Bw'olimpita mu buwuulu obw'obulamu bwonna, nfuula ow'ebibala mu ngeri ze sisobola na kulowooza. Nnyamba njagale era mpagire abalala mu kiseera kyonna, nga naawe bwe wanjagala. Mu linnya lya Yesu ery'omuwendo, Amiina.
fields.body_text: "Kitaawe w'abatalina ba kitaabwe, era omulamuzi wa bannamwandu, ye Katonda mu kifo kye ekitukuvu. Katonda atuuza abali bokka mu maka." Zabbuli 68:5-6 (KJV) Mu ssuula eyayita twalowooza ku kuyitibwa kw'omukyala Omukristaayo. Naye tetusaanidde kukyusa lupapula nga tetusoose kwogera ku baganda baffe abakazi abatafumbiddwa. Si buli mukazi ayitibwa okuba omukyala. Abamu ku mmwe abasoma kino muli bawuulu era musuubira okufumbirwa lumu olunaku. Abalala muli mu kiseera eky'okulinda, nga temumanyi Mukama ky'anaakola. Abalala mwafiirwa ba bbaabwe ne musigala bokka oluvannyuma lw'emyaka mingi egy'obufumbo. Abalala mwagattululwa oba ne mulekebwa awatali kyammusobezza. Ate abamu ku mmwe muyinza okuwulira nga Katonda abayita okusigala nga temufumbiddwa olw'obwakabaka bwe. Embeera yo yonna gy'eri, essuula eno ya ggwe. Toli muwala wa Katonda wa wansi olw'okuba tofumbiddwa. Oyagalibwa mu bujjuvu, oyitiddwa mu bujjuvu, era osobola mu bujjuvu okuleetera Kristo ekitiibwa ekinene. Ka njogere lwatu ku kunyigirizibwa abakazi abawuulu abangi kwe basanga — okunyigirizibwa okuwulirwa ennyo mu Buvanjuba bwa Afirika ne mu buwangwa obungi mu nsi yonna. Okuva mu buto, wabuuliddwa nti omuwendo gw'omukazi gupimibwa ku bufumbo. Ab'oluganda bakubuuza lw'olireeta omuntu eka. Baliraanwa beebuuza lwaki okyali wekka. Abamu batemya nti waliwo ekitali kituufu ku ggwe, oba oboolyawo nga wakolimirwa. Ab'omu maka bayinza okugezaako okukuwasiza mu bufumbo b'otoyagala. Okunyigirizibwa okufumbirwa — ne bwe kiba okufumbirwa atakkiriza oba omusajja ow'empisa embi olw'okufuna bbaawo bwakabaawo — kiyinza okuwulikika ng'ekikuziyiza okussa omukka. Muganda wange, wuliriza Ebyawandiikibwa bye bigamba. Obubadde bwo tebuli mu kuba omusajja yakulonda oba nedda. Obubadde bwo buli mu nsonga nti Kabaka w'Eggulu yakulonda. Yakwagala ng'ensi tennatondebwa. Yakufiirira ku musaalaba. Abeera mu ggwe olw'Omwoyo we. Tewali bufumbo bwa ku nsi obuyinza okwongera ku ekyo, era tewali buwuulu bwa ku nsi obuyinza okukiggyawo. Lowooza ku Mukama waffe Yesu yennyini. Yatambulira ku nsi eno emyaka amakumi asatu mu esatu, era teyawasa mukazi. Yali omuntu asinga okuba omulamu mu bujjuvu eyali abaddewo. Yali asinga okwagala, asinga essanyu, asinga okuba n'ekigendererwa. Omutima gwe tegwali mugabanye. Obulamu bwe tebwali butono olw'okuba teyafumbirwa. Mu butuufu, bwali bungi n'okusingawo — kubanga yali wa ddembe okwewaayo yekka mu bujjuvu eri omulimu Kitaawe gwe yamutuma okukola. Obanga obuwuulu bwali bulungi eri Mukama waffe, kale bulungi eri bawala be. Omutume Pawulo, mu Abakkolinso ow'olubereberye essuula ey'omusanvu, awandiika bijjuvu ku buwuulu n'obufumbo. Agamba lwatu nti omukazi atafumbiddwa afaayo ku by'a Mukama, alyoke abeere omutukuvu mu mubiri ne mu mwoyo. Asobola okuweereza Mukama awatali kusamaawalira. Pawulo tayigiriza nti obufumbo bubi — amaze okugamba nti obufumbo bwa kitiibwa. Ky'agamba kiri nti obuwuulu kirabo ekirina emikisa gyakyo egy'enjawulo. Omukazi Omukristaayo atafumbiddwa alina obudde, amaanyi, n'okussa omwoyo ku kimu, ebintu omukazi eyafumbirwa emirundi mingi by'atalina. Asobola okusaba okumala ebbanga eddene. Asobola okuweereza mu buziba obungi. Asobola okugenda omukazi eyafumbirwa gy'atasobola kugenda mangu. Asobola okwewaayo, awatali kwegabanya, eri omulimu gwa Mukama we. Tunuulira abakazi ab'omu Byawandiikibwa abaweereza Katonda n'amaanyi nga tebafumbiddwa. Ana nnabbi omukazi, gwe twasisinkana emabega, yafiirwa bba ng'awezezza emyaka musanvu gyokka egy'obufumbo. Yandiyise emyaka gye egyasigalawo mu bukyayi, ng'ayagala okumanya ekyandibaddewo. Mu kifo ky'ekyo, yeewaayo eri Mukama. Yamala emyaka egisukka mu nkaaga mu Yeekaalu, ng'asiiba era ng'asaba emisana n'ekiro, era yasasulwa nga ye omu ku basooka okutegeera Masiya omwana omuwere. Obuwuulu bwe tebwafiirwa bwereere. Bwe bwali ettaka lyennyini omwakulira obuweereza bwe obunene obw'okusaba. Malyamu ow'e Besaniya, mwannyina Maliza ne Laazaalo, tewali we kyogerwa nti yafumbirwa. Ajjukirwa olw'okutuula ku bigere bya Yesu ng'anywa okuyigiriza kwe. Ajjukirwa olw'okusiiga Yesu amafuta ag'omuwendo omungi ng'atannafa. Okwewaayo kwe okutali kwa kwegabanya eri Kristo kwali kulungi nnyo, Yesu yennyini n'agamba nti ekikolwa kye eky'okwagala kinaabuulirwanga buli wonna enjiri gy'ebuulirwa, okutuuka ku nkomerero y'omulembe. Malyamu Magadaleene, Yesu gwe yagoba dayimoni musanvu, yamugoberera mu ntambula ze, yawagira obuweereza bwe okuva mu bintu bye ye, yayimirira ku ntobo y'omusaalaba abasajja abasinga bwe baali baddukidde, era ye yasooka okulaba Mukama azuukidde ku makya g'okuzuukira. Tewali kya mu Byawandiikibwa ekiraga nti yali afumbiddwa. Obulamu bwe bwonna yabuwaayo eri Omulokozi we. Ludiya ow'e Firipi yali n'akatale ke ak'okutunda engoye eza ffulungu. Tewali bba ayogerwako. Yakulembera ab'omu maka ge mu kubatizibwa oluvannyuma lw'okukyuka kwe. Yasembeza ekkanisa esooka mu Bulaaya mu maka ge. Ka abe nga yafiirwa bba oba nga teyali afumbiddwa n'akatono, yakozesa eddembe lye, ebintu bye, n'amaka ge olw'Obwakabaka bwa Katonda. Doluka ow'e Yopa yatungira bannamwandu engoye. Bawala bana aba Firipo omubuulizi w'enjiri, embeerera, baawa obunnabbi mu maanyi g'Omwoyo. Miryamu yakulembera abakazi ba Isirayeri mu luyimba oluvannyuma lw'okusomoka Ennyanja Emyufu. Emirundi n'emirundi, Ebyawandiikibwa biwa ekitiibwa ekyo abakazi abaali batafumbiddwa kye baawaayo. Ebyafaayo by'Ekkanisa bijjudde abakazi abawuulu abaabala ebibala eby'ekitalo. Amy Carmichael yava mu Bukiika kkono bwa Ayalandi n'agenda mu Buyindi mu 1895 era teyafumbirwa. Yatandika Dohnavur Fellowship, ekiddukiro ky'abawala abaali bawalirizibwa okuba abamalaaya ab'omu masabo. Yataasa abaana enkumi, yawandiika ebitabo ebisukka mu amakumi asatu, era yaweereza mu Buyindi emyaka amakumi ataano mu etaano awatali kuddayo waka n'omulundi n'ogumu. Mary Slessor ow'e Sukoti, gwe twasisinkana emabega, yayogezebwako emirundi ebiri okufumbirwa naye n'asigala nga tafumbiddwa olw'enjiri. Yatwala abaana enfuuzi mwenda, yamalawo okutta abaana abalongo mu bantu be yaweerezanga mu Bugwanjuba bwa Afirika, era yaggulawo ekkubo ly'enjiri mu bitundu omutaali mubuulizi n'omu eyali agezezaako okuyingira. Gladys Aylward yatambulira ku nsozi za Cayina ng'akulembera abaana enfuuzi kikumi okutuuka mu bukuumi mu kiseera Abayapaani lwe baali balumba. Helen Roseveare yaweereza ng'omubuulizi w'obusawo omuwuulu mu Kongo, yagumira okubonaabona okunene, era yasimba amalwaliro n'amakanisa agakyaliwo n'okutuusa leero. Corrie ten Boom, oluvannyuma lw'okukweka Abayudaaya okuva ku Banazi n'awonawo mu kkambi ery'okusibirwamu, yamala obulamu bwe obwasigalawo ng'abuulira ensi nti tewali bunnya buwanvu nnyo okwagala kwa Katonda ne kutasinga buziba. Buli omu ku bakazi bano yali muwuulu. Buli omu ku bo yakyusa ensi. Kaakati wuliriza amazima gano amalungi, era ka gakkakkane wansi mu mutima gwo. Tewali Mukristaayo ali yekka mu butuufu. Wazaalibwa omulundi ogwokubiri mu maka ga Katonda. Omutume Pawulo awandiika mu Abaefeso nti tetukyali bagwira na batambuze, wabula tuli bantu b'ekibuga awamu n'abatukuvu era ab'omu nnyumba ya Katonda. Zabbuli ey'amakumi mukaaga mu munaana egamba nti Katonda atuuza abali bokka mu maka. Yesu bwe yabuulirwa nti nnyina ne baganda be baali ebweru nga bamunoonya, yatunuulira abayigirizwa be n'agamba nti buli akola Katonda by'ayagala oyo ye muganda we ne mwannyina ne nnyina. Ekkanisa ye maka go. Abakkiriza abakulu bafuuka ba maama bo ne ba kitaawo mu kukkiriza. Abakkiriza abato bafuuka batabani bo ne bawala bo ab'omwoyo. Bannaabwe abakkiriza ab'emyaka gyo bafuuka baganda bo ne bannyoko mu Kristo. Olina amaka amanene era ag'omuwendo okusinga amaka gonna ag'omusaayi ge gasobola okubaawo. Kino si ndowooza nnungi buwoomu. Bwe butuufu obw'omu bulamu obuteekwa okubeeramu mu kkanisa ey'omu kitundu. Bw'oba omukazi omuwuulu, teweekweka waka. Jjangu mu kussa kimu. Weeleke omanyibwe. Noonya omukazi omukulu asobola okukulabirira nga maama. Noonya abakazi abato b'osobola okuzzaamu amaanyi. Lya mu maka g'ab'amaka, era yita ab'amaka mu maka go. Kwata Ssekukkulu ne Paska n'abatukuvu bw'oba tolina ba luganda okumpi. Nakuwala mu mikono gyabwe ennaku bw'ejja. Sanyukira awamu nabo mu ssanyu lyabwe. Kino kye omubiri gwa Kristo kye guliko. Ka njogere mu ngeri ey'obukugu kaakati. Bw'oba omuwuulu mu kiseera kino, oba kaakati oba obulamu bwo bwonna, olina okubeera otya? Ekisooka, ssa Katonda mu maaso n'omutima ogutali mugabanye. Kino ky'ekiseera kyo eky'enjawulo eky'omukisa. Saba okusingawo. Soma okusingawo. Siiba oluusi. Muwulirize. Mukkirize abeere okwagala kwo okusooka era okusinga obuziba. Omukazi omutima gwe guteeredde ddala ku Mukama tayinza kunyeenyezebwa nkulungizo z'ensi. Guno gwe musingi gwa buli kimu ekirala. Eky'okubiri, kkiriza amaka g'ekkanisa. Teweeyawula. Tosigala waka ku Ssande olw'okuwulira ng'otagerageranyizibwa ng'omukazi omu yekka atafumbiddwa mu lunyiriri lwo. Tobuuka okussa kimu okw'abakazi olw'okulabika ng'okujjudde bakyala ne bamaama. Jjangu. Weereza. Yagala ab'amaka mu kkanisa yo. Saba bannyoko abakulu ab'omutima ogutya Katonda batambule naawe. Omubiri gwa Kristo gube maka go, si mu linnya lyokka wabula mu bikolwa bya buli lunaku. Eky'okusatu, weereza n'omutima gwo gwonna. Olina obudde abakazi abafumbiddwa emirundi mingi bwe batalina. Olina amaanyi ag'okuwaayo. Lowooza ku buweereza obw'ebweru. Lowooza ku kuyigiriza. Lowooza ku kutandika obuweereza eri bannamwandu, oba enfuuzi, oba abawala abavubuka, oba abakazi ab'omu kkomera. Lowooza ku kugenda abalala gye batasobola kugenda mangu. Obwakabaka bwa Katonda bulina bulijjo okukulaakulanyizibwa mu kitundu ekinene abakazi abawuulu abaali n'eddembe ery'okwewaayo mu bujjuvu. Wayinza okubaawo omulimu Katonda gw'akutegekedde omuntu omulala gw'atasobola kukola. Eky'okuna, kola nnyo era noonya obulungi obw'ekitalo. Toteeka bulamu bwo mu kutuula ng'olinda bufumbo. Noonya okuyiga kwo. Kulaakulana mu mulimu gwo. Tandika bizinensi. Simba olusuku. Gula ettaka. Yiga obukugu. Wandiika ekitabo. Tereka ssente zo n'amagezi. Ba omukazi owa Engero 31 mu kiseera ky'obulamu ky'olimu. Kumpi buli kitundu ekya essuula eyo ennungi kikwata ku mukazi omuwuulu nga bwe kikwata ku eyafumbirwa. Omukazi omuwuulu omukozi era atya Katonda bujulizi bwa maanyi mu mulembe ogw'obugayaavu n'okwemulugunya. Eky'okutaano, kuuma omutima gwo n'omubiri gwo. Obulongoofu bukulu nnyo. Toweeyawo eri omusajja atannaakwewaayo mu maaso ga Katonda ne mu maaso g'Ekkanisa. Togendera n'abatakkiriza, ne bwe baba nga ba kisa oba abalabika obulungi — tosobola kuzimba maka Gakristaayo ku musingi ogutali gwa Kikristaayo. Tokkiriza bulimba nti obufumbo obubi businga obutafumbirwa. Tebwenkanankana. Obuwuulu obutya Katonda businga emirundi lukumi obufumbo obutatya Katonda. Linda ekisinga obulungi ekya Katonda. Bw'atalireeta bufumbo, kale ky'anaakuleetera mu kifo kyakyo kinaaba kirungi kyenkanyi, kubanga Kitaawe omulungi. Eky'omukaaga, kuza okumatira. Okumatira si kuggwaamu ssuubi. Si kuleka bufumbo oba okwefuula nti tobwagala. Bwe mirembe emiziba egy'okwesiga nti Katonda mulungi era enteekateeka ye ku bulamu bwo nnungi. Pawulo yawandiika ng'ali mu kkomera ery'e Ruumi nti yali ayize, mu mbeera yonna mwe yabeeranga, okumatira. Okuyiga okwo lugendo. Kujja okuyita mu kusaba, mu Byawandiikibwa, mu mulimu omuggavu ogw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Saba Katonda akuyigirize ekisa kino. Ekigambo eri abo abaafiirwa ba bbaabwe. Katonda alaba ennaku yo. Ali kumpi n'abalina emitima egimenyeka. Isaaya essuula ey'amakumi ataano mu ena egamba nti Omutonzi wo ye bba wo — Mukama w'eggye lye linnya lye. Talikuleka. Zuula okusanyusibwa mu ye, era zuula amaka go mu Kkanisa. Abakazi bangi ku abasinga amaanyi mu Byawandiikibwa ne mu byafaayo baali bannamwandu. Emyaka gyo egisinga obulungi egy'obuweereza giyinza okuba gikyali mu maaso. Ekigambo eri abo abaagattululwa oba abaalekebwa. Toli bintu byonoonese. Katonda azaawulula ebintu byonna asobola okukuzza obuggya. Ebyayita byonna bye biri, omusaayi gwa Yesu gukufuula omulongoofu era omuggya. Toleka nsonyi kukuziyiza kukwatanwa n'abakkiriza. Jjangu. Weereza. Yagala. Oli waabwe. Muganda wange, oba ofumbiddwa oba omuwuulu, oba nnamwandu oba olinda, oyagalibwa. Mukama takwerabidde. Awandiika olugero lwo, era lulungi, wadde obulungi obujjuvu bulirabika mu bwomu bwokka. Mwesige mu kiseera kino eky'obulamu bwo. Tokifiirikiriza ng'olinda ekiseera ekirala okutandika. Mulisa awo Katonda w'akusimbye. Weereza awo Katonda w'akuteeka. Yagala oyo Katonda gw'atadde mu maaso go. Ensi erimanya nti mwenyini, mu kitundu, olw'essanyu eriri ku maaso g'omukazi Omukristaayo omuwuulu eyazuula byonna bye mu ye. Okusaba Kitaffe ali mu ggulu, nkwebaza olw'okuba obubadde bwange tebuli mu kufumbirwa, wabula mu nsonga nti ndi wuwo. Weebale okunfuula omuwala wo n'okunteeka mu maka go amanene, Ekkanisa. Bwe mba omuwuulu mu kiseera kino, nnyamba nkozese ekiseera kino olw'ekitiibwa kyo. Mpa omutima ogutali mugabanye. Nfuula omukazi ow'okusaba, ow'okuweereza, n'ow'ekigendererwa. Nkuuma nneme okwolumbwa obwesudde n'okumatira ku ekitono okusinga ekisinga obulungi ekikyo. Neetoolooze baganda bange ne bannyinaze abanjagala nga ab'omu maka go. Bw'olimpita mu bufumbo lumu olunaku, nteekateeka era omuteekateeke naye. Bw'olimpita mu buwuulu obw'obulamu bwonna, nfuula ow'ebibala mu ngeri ze sisobola na kulowooza. Nnyamba njagale era mpagire abalala mu kiseera kyonna, nga naawe bwe wanjagala. Mu linnya lya Yesu ery'omuwendo, Amiina.

fields.title: Okulabirira Omulembe Oguddako: Okukuza Abaana ab'Okutya Katonda
fields.body_html:
"N'ebigambo bino bye nkulagira leero, binaabanga mu mutima gwo: era onaabiyigirizanga abaana bo n'obunyiikivu, era onaabyogerangako bw'onootuulanga mu nnyumba yo, ne bw'onootambulanga mu kkubo, ne bw'onoogalamiranga, ne bw'onoogolokokanga." Ekyamateeka 6:6-7 (KJV) Tewali ttaka lya kutuukirizaako buweereza erisinga ennyumba yo ggwe wennyini. Abaana Katonda b'akuwadde okulabirira be mulembe oguddako ogw'Ekkanisa, be bakulembeze abaddako ab'omu kitundu kyo n'eggwanga lyo. Engeri gye banaakulizibwamu eriyamba okusalawo oba enjiri erikulaakulana oba erikendeera mu nsi yo mu myaka egijja. Era wansi wa Katonda, tewali n'omu asinga maama okuba n'obuyinza ku mwana mu myaka egisooka.

Mu Ndagaano Enkadde, Katonda yawa abazadde ebiragiro ebitegeerekeka. Shema, mu Ekyamateeka essuula omukaaga, egamba abazadde okuyigiriza abaana baabwe amateeka ga Katonda n'obunyiikivu. Ekigambo "n'obunyiikivu" kikulu. Si kuyigiriza kwa bulijjo mu bunafu, si kintu ekikolebwa ku Ssande enkya zokka, naye kwa bulijjo, okutasalako, okulukibwa mu buli kaseera ak'obulamu. Bw'otambula, bw'otuula, bw'ogalamira, bw'ogolokoka — amazima ga Katonda gateekwa okwogerwa, okulagirwa mu bikolwa, n'okuddibwamu.

Lowooza ku Yokebedi, maama wa Musa. Yali abeera wansi w'ekiragiro kya Falaawo ekyabi nti abaana aboobulenzi Abaebbulaniya bonna basaanidde okusuulibwa mu Kiyira. Naye yatya Katonda okusinga bwe yatya Falaawo. Yakweka omwana we emyezi esatu. Awo, bwe yalema okumukweka nate, yakola akasero akatono ak'ebitoogo, yakabikkako envumbo, n'ateeka omwana we omunda, n'akateeka mu bitoogo eby'omu mugga. Muwala we Miryamu yali akuuma okumpi. Muwala wa Falaawo bwe yazuula omwana, Miryamu n'asembera n'agamba nti anaanoonya omukazi Omuebbulaniya okuyonsa omwana. Mu bulabirizi bwa Katonda, Yokebedi yapangisibwa okuyonsa omwana we ye. Mu myaka egisooka egy'obulamu bwe — oboolyawo emyaka esatu oba ena, nga mu biseera ebyo abaana bwe baayonsebwanga — Musa yakulira mu mikono gya maama we, ng'awulira ebya Katonda wa Ibulayimu, Isaaka, ne Yakobo. Yalina emyaka mitono mibiri gyokka egy'okufuka mu ye nga tannaweebwayo mu lubiri lwa Falaawo. Naye emyaka egyo gyali gimala. Obwe Musa bwennyini bwali bunyweziddwa.

Yamanya gwe yali. Yamanya nga wa ani. Era oluvannyuma lw'emyaka mingi, yalonda okubonaabona wamu n'abantu ba Katonda okusinga okwesanyusa mu masanyu ag'ekibi ag'akaseera akatono. Bamaama, temwerabiranga muwendo gw'emyaka egyo egisooka. Kyonna ky'osimba mu myaka etaano egisooka egy'obulamu bw'omwana kiribala ebibala obulamu bwonna.

Lowooza ku Kaana nate. Bwe yafuna omwana we Samwiri, teyamunywegera. Yamuggya ku mabeere, n'alyoka amuleeta mu weema ey'okusisinkana n'amuwaayo okuweereza Mukama ennaku zonna ez'obulamu bwe.

Buli mwaka yajjanga n'amuleetera akakooti akatono ke yali amukoledde. Lowooza ku ekyo. Buli mwaka yatunganga akakooti n'akatuusa eri omwana we, eyali aweereza mu nnyumba ya Katonda. Samwiri yakulira mu maaso ga Mukama. Maama we yali amuwaddeyo nga tannazaalibwa, era yeeyongera okufuka mu ye n'oluvannyuma lw'okuva mu maka ge. Waayo abaana bo eri Katonda, mwannyinaze. Si mu mukolo gw'okuwaayo omwana gwokka, naye buli lunaku. Bateeke ku kyoto kya Mukama mu kusaba. Weesige Katonda okubakozesa olw'ekitiibwa Kye.

Lowooza ku Ewuniki ne Lowiisi, maama ne jjajja wa Timoseewo. Pawulo awandiika nti okukkiriza okutaliimu bukuusa okwali mu Timoseewo kwasooka okubeera mu jjajja we Lowiisi ne mu maama we Ewuniki. Emirembe esatu egy'okukkiriza mu maka gamu. Ate nga kitaawe wa Timoseewo yali Muyonaani, oboolyawo nga si mukkiriza.

Oluusi maama ne jjajja ab'okutya Katonda beetikka omugugu gw'eby'omwoyo ogw'amaka. Baagwetikka n'obwesigwa. Era Timoseewo yafuuka omusumba era munne wa Pawulo omuko. Mwannyinaze, ka baba nga balo mukulembeze wa mwoyo ow'amaanyi oba nedda, oyinza okuba Ewuniki era Lowiisi. Osobola okukuza abaana abamanyi ebyawandiikibwa okuva mu nnaku zaabwe ezisooka.

Kaakano ka njogere mu ngeri ey'obukugu. Okuza otya abaana ab'okutya Katonda mu nsi eya leero, ng'ebintu bingi bikusika okukuvuganya — obwavu, okunyigirizibwa mu bannaawo, eby'amasanyu ebitaliimu mpisa, amasomero agatayigiriza mpisa za Kikristaayo, ne baganda abatakkiriza?

Ekisooka, teekawo okusinza kw'amaka. Buli lunaku, bwe kisoboka. Kuŋŋaanya amaka, ne bwe kiba kya ddakiika kkumi oba kkumi na ttaano zokka. Soma ekitundu ekitono eky'ebyawandiikibwa. Kinnyonnyole mu bigambo ebyangu. Saba. Yimba oluyimba olw'okutendereza. Bw'oba n'abaana abato, kifuule kimpi. Bwe bakula, kifuule kya buggagga. Tokibulanga ne bw'oba okooye. Ne bwe wabaawo emirimu mingi mu nnyumba. Obunywevu bw'okusinza kw'amaka bulikuza abaana bo okusinga okubuulira kwonna kwe bawulira ku Ssande.

Ekyokubiri, bayigirize okusaba. Sooka obayigirize essaala ennyangu. Bawebaze Katonda olw'emmere. Bawebaze Katonda olw'olunaku. Basabire kitaabwe ng'ali ku mirimu. Basabire ow'oluganda omulwadde.

Bwe bakula, bayigirize okusaba. Bayigirize okwesabira, okusabira mikwano gyabwe, basomesa baabwe, eggwanga lyabwe. Omwana ayiga okusaba nga mutono aliba muntu mukulu asaba.

Ekyokusatu, bayigirize okuwulira. Ebyawandiikibwa bilagira abaana okussa ekitiibwa n'okuwulira bazadde baabwe. Kino kye kiragiro ekisooka ekirimu ekisuubizo. Omwana atayiga kuwulira muzadde alifuna obuzibu oluvannyuma okuwulira mukama we ow'emirimu, omusumba, oba Mukama yennyini. Totya kukangavvula. Ekitabo ky'Engero kigamba nti akekkereza oluga akyawa mutabani we, naye amwagala amukangavvula mu bwangu. Naye okukangavvula tekusaana kukolebwa mu busungu oba mu bukambwe. Kiteekwa okukolebwa mu kwagala, n'okunnyonnyola, ne kuddiriramu okusonyiyibwa n'okwagalibwa. Abaana bo tebasaana kubuusabuusa nti obaagala, ne bw'oba oteekwa okubatereeza.

Ekyokuna, bayigirize enjawulo wakati w'ekituufu n'ekikyamu mu bulamu obwa bulijjo. Bayigirize okwogera amazima. Bayigirize okukola nnyo mu masomo gaabwe. Bayigirize okuba ba kisa eri baganda baabwe. Bayigirize okuyamba mu nnyumba — abalenzi n'abawala kyenkanyi basaana okuyigirizibwa okukima amazzi, okuyera, n'okuyamba mu kufumba. Bayigirize okussa ekitiibwa mu bakulu baabwe. Bayigirize okuba abesimbu mu byambalo ne mu bigambo byabwe. Bayigirize okwewala emikwano emibi, kubanga banne ababi boonoona empisa ennungi.

Ekyokutaano, babuulire ebifumu. Bamaama bulijjo baabanga bakugu mu kubuulira ebifumu, era tewali buwangwa businga obwa Afirika mu kino. Babuulire ebifumu eby'omu Bayibuli — Nuuwa n'amataba, Dawudi ne Goliyaasi, Danyeri n'empologoma, Omusamaliya omulungi, omwana omwononefu. Babuulire ebifumu by'Abajjulirwa ba Uganda, ku Kizito omuto ne Mbaga ne Gyaviira, abafiira okukkiriza kwabwe okusinga okwegaana. Babuulire ku Mary Slessor, omukazi omutono Omusukoti eyagenda mu Bugwanjuba bwa Afirika n'awonya obulamu bw'abaana abalongo abaali balekeddwa okufa. Babuulire ku Simeoni Nsibambi, eyasabira okuzuukuka mu Uganda. Ebifumu bissa amazima mu mutima mu ngeri okuyigiriza kw'obulijjo kwe kutasobola.

Ekyomukaaga, beeyo naabwe. Abaana tebafaayo nnyo ku birabo eby'omuwendo nga bwe bafaayo ku budde bwo, okussaako omwoyo gwo, n'okwagala kwo. Tuula nabo. Bawulirize. Manya amannya gaabwe, mikwano gyabwe, ebibatiisa, ebirooto byabwe. Manya ebibaawo mu ssomero lyabwe, mu mutima gwabwe, mu bulamu bwabwe.

Abaana abawulira nga bamanyiddwa era baagalibwa mu maka tebaanguyirwa kudduka okugenda mu nsi nga banoonya okwagala awalala.

Ekyomusanvu, laga mu bikolwa ky'oyigiriza. Abaana bayiga okusinga okuva mu ky'okola okusinga ky'oyogera.

Bw'obabuulira obutalimba naye ne bakuwulira ng'olimba muliraanwa, balireeka okulimba. Bw'obabuulira okusonyiwa naye ne bakulaba ng'okwata ekiruyi, balikwata ekiruyi. Bw'obabuulira okusaba naye ne batakulabako ng'osaba, tebalisaba. Naye bw'obeera ky'oyigiriza, kiriwandiikibwa mu mitima gyabwe.

Toweddemu mwoyo abaana bo bwe batalaga mangu ebibala eby'okuyigiriza kwo. Abaana abamu bakkiriza mangu. Abalala bayita mu kiseera eky'okuwaba nga tebannadda.

Jjukira Agusito ne Monika. Emyaka amakumi asatu egy'amaziga n'okusaba gye gyakulembera okukyusibwa kwe. Weeyongere okusiga. Weeyongere okusaba. Katonda eyatandika omulimu omulungi mu maka go aliba mwesigwa okugutuukiriza.

Ekintu ekimu ekirala. Abamu ku mmwe abasoma kino oboolyawo temulina baana bammwe bennyini. Oboolyawo Katonda tannabawa baana. Oboolyawo yabalondera ekkubo eddala mu bulamu bwammwe. Temuwulira nti essuula eno tebakwatako. Katonda ayinza okukuwa bajjwa okufuka mu bo. Ayinza okukuwa abaana ab'obuwala mu kukkiriza. Ayinza okukuwa obuweereza eri bamulekwa — era Katonda amanyi nti ensi eno erina bamulekwa bangi abeetaaga bamaama Abakristaayo mu kukkiriza. Omutima gwa maama Katonda gwe yateeka mu ggwe gusobola okukuza abaana bangi, ka baba nga baava mu mubiri gwo oba nedda.

Essaala Kitange, nkuleetera abaana ab'omu bulamu bwange. Nkwebaza olw'abo. Nnyamba okubalaba nga bw'obalaba — ng'emyoyo egitaggwaawo gy'ompadde okulabirira. Mpa amaanyi okubayigiriza amakubo Go n'obunyiikivu. Mpa amagezi bwe nsaana okubatereeza. Mpa obugumiikiriza bwe mba nkooye. Babikke n'okusaasira Kwo bwe ngwa. Bawonye, Mukama wange.

Bayite mu bwakabaka Bwo. Bakozese olw'ebigendererwa Byo. Ka amaka gange gabeere ekifo Gy'omanyiddwamu era Gy'oyagalibwamu, era omulembe oguddako gye guyigira okutambula naawe. Mu linnya lya Yesu, Amiina.
fields.body_text: "N'ebigambo bino bye nkulagira leero, binaabanga mu mutima gwo: era onaabiyigirizanga abaana bo n'obunyiikivu, era onaabyogerangako bw'onootuulanga mu nnyumba yo, ne bw'onootambulanga mu kkubo, ne bw'onoogalamiranga, ne bw'onoogolokokanga." Ekyamateeka 6:6-7 (KJV) Tewali ttaka lya kutuukirizaako buweereza erisinga ennyumba yo ggwe wennyini. Abaana Katonda b'akuwadde okulabirira be mulembe oguddako ogw'Ekkanisa, be bakulembeze abaddako ab'omu kitundu kyo n'eggwanga lyo. Engeri gye banaakulizibwamu eriyamba okusalawo oba enjiri erikulaakulana oba erikendeera mu nsi yo mu myaka egijja. Era wansi wa Katonda, tewali n'omu asinga maama okuba n'obuyinza ku mwana mu myaka egisooka. Mu Ndagaano Enkadde, Katonda yawa abazadde ebiragiro ebitegeerekeka. Shema, mu Ekyamateeka essuula omukaaga, egamba abazadde okuyigiriza abaana baabwe amateeka ga Katonda n'obunyiikivu. Ekigambo "n'obunyiikivu" kikulu. Si kuyigiriza kwa bulijjo mu bunafu, si kintu ekikolebwa ku Ssande enkya zokka, naye kwa bulijjo, okutasalako, okulukibwa mu buli kaseera ak'obulamu. Bw'otambula, bw'otuula, bw'ogalamira, bw'ogolokoka — amazima ga Katonda gateekwa okwogerwa, okulagirwa mu bikolwa, n'okuddibwamu. Lowooza ku Yokebedi, maama wa Musa. Yali abeera wansi w'ekiragiro kya Falaawo ekyabi nti abaana aboobulenzi Abaebbulaniya bonna basaanidde okusuulibwa mu Kiyira. Naye yatya Katonda okusinga bwe yatya Falaawo. Yakweka omwana we emyezi esatu. Awo, bwe yalema okumukweka nate, yakola akasero akatono ak'ebitoogo, yakabikkako envumbo, n'ateeka omwana we omunda, n'akateeka mu bitoogo eby'omu mugga. Muwala we Miryamu yali akuuma okumpi. Muwala wa Falaawo bwe yazuula omwana, Miryamu n'asembera n'agamba nti anaanoonya omukazi Omuebbulaniya okuyonsa omwana. fields.title: Okuddukanya Amaka Go n'Amagezi
fields.body_html:
"Alabirira obulungi amakubo g'ab'omu nnyumba ye, so talya mmere ya bunafu." Engero 31:27 (KJV) Essuula ey'amakumi asatu mu emu mu Ngero eleeta ekifaananyi ky'omukazi ow'ekitalo. Yamanyiddwa nga omukazi omutuukirivu oba omukazi wa Engero 31. Bba amwesiga. Abaana be bagolokoka ne bamuyita ow'omukisa. Akola n'emikono egyeteefuteefu. Agolokoka nga bukyali kiro okuteekerateekera ab'omu maka ge emmere. Alowooza ku nnimiro n'agigula. Asimba olusuku lw'emizabbibu. Akola engoye n'azitundira abasuubuzi. Agololera emikono gye abaavu n'abeetaavu. Ayambadde amaanyi n'ekitiibwa, era aseka olunaku olujja. Ono si mukazi munafu. Ono mukazi wa maanyi, ow'amagezi, omunyiikivu, era atya Katonda. Era wakati mu bulamu bwe waliwo amaka ge.

Okuddukanya amaka si kuyitibwa kutono. Tekusinga bukulu okuvuga bizinensi oba okukola omulimu mu ofiisi. Mu ngeri nnyingi, kikulu okusinga, kubanga amaka ge omulembe ogujja gye gubumbirwa. Amaka ag'emirembe era agategekeddwa obulungi bujulizi bwa maanyi eri enjiri. Amaka ag'akasasamalo era ag'entalo gagoba buli omu ali mu go — bba, abaana, n'abagenyi — okulaga oluggi.

Bayibuli egamba nti omukazi ow'amagezi azimba ennyumba ye, naye omukazi omusirusiru agimenya n'emikono gye. Kitegeeza ki okuzimba ennyumba yo? Ka mbayite mu bitundu ebiwerako.

Ekisooka, waliwo okutegeka ennyumba mu ngeri ey'omubiri. Ennyumba yo teyeetaaga kuba nnene oba nnungi okuba amaka amalungi. Osobola okufuula n'ennyumba esinga obunafu — akasenge kamu akapangisa, ennyumba ey'amatoffaali g'ebbumba erina akasolya k'amabaati — ekifo eky'emirembe eri ab'omu maka go. Ekikulu bwe buyonjo, entegeka, n'okufaayo. Yeza wansi. Naaza ebintu. Yoza engoye. Kuuma oluggya nga terulimu bisasiro. Yigiriza abaana bo okuyamba mu bino nga bakyali bato. Si nsonyi omukazi okuba omukugu mu mirimu gy'omu nnyumba. Kintu kirungi. Omukazi Omusunami mu 2 Bassekabaka essuula ey'okuna kyakulabirako kirungi nnyo. Yalaba nga nnabbi Erisa ayitanga mu kibuga kye emirundi mingi, n'agamba bba nti, "Ka tumukolere akasenge akatono ku bbugwe, tuteekemu ekitanda, emmeeza, entebe, n'ettaala." Yateekateeka. Yategeka. Yakozesa bye yalina okuwa omuntu wa Katonda omukisa. Amaka ge gaali mu ntegeka nnungi ekimusobozesa okusembeza abagenyi buli kiseera.

Ekyokubiri, waliwo okuliisa ab'omu maka. Omukazi wa Engero 31 aleeta emmere ye okuva ewala.

Agolokoka bukyali n'awa ab'omu nnyumba ye emmere. Okuliisa amaka obulungi, ku ssente ntono, gwe gumu ku bukugu obukulu obw'omukazi Omukristaayo omufumbo. Yiga okufumba obulungi emmere y'abantu bo — ka gabe matooke, obugali n'enva endiirwa, oba omuceere, ebijanjaalo n'omugaati, oba kyonna ekiriisa amaka g'omu nsi yo. Yiga okuterekera emmere — okukaza, okunyookeza, okutayira — waleme okuwaayo ekifa obwereere. Yigiriza abawala bo okufumba. Tobaleka kukula nga tebasobola kulabirira maka. Emmere si ya kulya kwokka. Ekwata ku bulamu bw'amaka.

Emmeeza ey'ekyekiro gye tuwanyisiganya olunaku, gye wabaawo okuyigiriza, gye wasabirwa, gye wanyweza enkolagana. Fuula ebiseera eby'okulya eby'enjawulo, ne bwe kuba emmere ntono.

Ekyokusatu, waliwo okuddukanya ssente. Kino kye kimu ku bitundu ebisinga obuzibu eri amaka mangi.

Ssente zijja mu ngeri etategeerekeka. Ebyetaago biba bingi. Okunyigirizibwa kuva eri ab'oluganda.

Okukemebwa kujjula wonna. Naye omukazi Omukristaayo ow'amagezi ayiga okukwata ssente n'obwegendereza, ng'agoberera emisingi gya Bayibuli. Sooka okuwa Mukama — Bayibuli etuyigiriza okuwa Mukama ekitiibwa n'ebibala ebibereberye eby'ebyengera byaffe byonna. Tereka ekintu, ne bwe kuba kitono. Omukazi wa Engero 31 yagula ennimiro okuva mu byengera bye ye, ekitegeeza nti yasobola okutereka n'okussa ssente mu bizinensi. Weewale amabanja, naddala eri abo abasala amagoba amangi. Beera mu ngeri gy'osobola okuwa. Teekateeka ku bintu by'omanyi nga bijja — ebisale by'essomero, ensimbi z'eddwaliro, embaga z'okuziika. Tosaasaanya ssente ku bintu eby'obusirusiru ng'ebintu ebyetaagisa tebifunibwa. Kolera awamu ne bba ku nsonga zino. Tomukwekera by'osaasaanya. Musabire wamu ku nsalawo z'ensimbi.

Ekyokuna, waliwo okuteekawo embeera ey'omu maka. Kino kizibu okupima naye oboolyawo kikulu okusinga buli kintu ekirala. Mpisa ki eriwo mu maka go? Ya mirembe oba ya kutya? Ya ssanyu oba nzitowavu? Kifo abantu kye baagala okujja oba ekifo abantu kye baagala okudduka? Omwoyo gw'amaka gubumbibwa nnyo omukazi ali mu go. Singa omukazi era nnyina eyeeraliikirira, amaka gonna galiraaliikirira. Bw'aba omuyombi, amaka gonna galiyomba. Bw'aba yeesiga Katonda era atambulira mu ssanyu, amaka gonna galiwulira emirembe. Oyinza obutasobola kufuga ebiliwo ebweru w'omulyango gwo, naye olw'ekisa kya Katonda, osobola okuteekawo embeera munda mu mulyango gwo. Kuba ennyimba ennungi ez'enjiri. Kuuma leediyo oba tterevi nga byewala emikutu egitatya Katonda. Sembeza abantu. Wabeewo okuseka. Wabeewo okusaba. Okutya Mukama kubeere ku maka go.

Ekyokutaano, waliwo okusembeza abagenyi. Ettaala y'omukazi wa Engero 31 tezikira kiro. Amaka ge kifo abalala gye basembezebwa. Mu buwangwa obungi — era obuwangwa bw'omu Buvanjuba bwa Afirika bugagga mu kino — okusembeza abagenyi mpisa ya muwendo era nnungi nnyo. Toleka mbiro z'obulamu obw'omulembe kutta mpisa eno ey'edda. Ggulawo amaka go eri abakkiriza abalala.

Ggulawo amaka go eri baliraanwa. Ggulawo amaka go eri abavubuka abeetaaga ssenga atya Katonda. Ggulawo amaka go eri omuweereza w'enjiri oba omubuulizi atambula. Wa omuntu chai. Wa omuntu emmere bw'osobola. Wa okutu kwo okuwuliriza n'okusaba kwo.

Ekyomukaaga, waliwo okuzimba ebijjukizo n'obulombolombo. Kwata amazaalibwa mu ngeri ennyangu naye ey'amakulu. Jjukira Ssekukkulu ne Paska n'okusinza n'ebiseera eby'amaka. Tondawo obweyisi obutono — emmere ey'oku Ssande oluvannyuma lw'okuva mu kkanisa, okuyonja oluggya ku Lwomukaaga, okusaba akawungeezi nga tebannaba kwebaka. Obulombolombo buno buluka amaka wamu era buwa abaana okuwulira okw'amaanyi okw'okubeera ekitundu ky'amaka.

Ka njogere akangambo ku bwenkanya. Omukazi wa Engero 31 yakola ebintu bingi, naye teyakola byonna mu kiseera kimu, era teyabikola yekka. Yalina abaweereza. Yayigiriza ab'omu maka ge. Yakolera awamu ne bba. Toweesuubira kuba muggya mu buli kitundu mu buli kiseera ky'obulamu. Abaana bwe baba abato ennyo, tojja kubeera na budde bwa kusimba lusuku lwa mizabbibu. Abaana bwe bakula, olina obudde obw'okukola emirimu egy'ebweru. Twala ebiro nga bwe biri. Saba Katonda amagezi ku ky'okukola n'eky'okuleka.

Ekirowoozo ekisembayo. Mu buwangwa obungi waliwo essuubi ery'amaanyi nti omukazi era nnyina anaaweerezanga awatali kuwummula era awatali kkomo. Afumba, ayonja, alima, akolera ebweru, alabirira abaana, alabirira ab'oluganda. Bw'atali mwegendereza, ayinza okukoowa, okuba omukyayi, n'okunyiiga. Mwannyinaze, yiga okuwummula. Katonda yennyini yawummula ku lunaku olw'omusanvu. Ne omukazi wa Engero 31 ateekwa okuba nga yeebakanga ekiseera ekimu. Tolagajjalira mubiri gwo n'emmeeme yo. Weebake bimala. Lya bulungi. Tuula mu kasirise ne Mukama. Saba bba n'abaana abakulu okukuyamba. Saba bannyinazo Abakristaayo okukuwagira. Tosobola kuwaayo ng'ekikopo kyo kikalu.

Okusaba. Mukama, njigiriza okuddukanya amaka gange n'amagezi. Nnyamba okuzimba amaka gange so si okugamenya. Mpa obukugu mu mikono gyange, entegeka mu makubo gange, n'emirembe mu mwoyo gwange. Nnyamba okuba omukisa eri bba, abaana bange, n'abo bonna abayingira mu maka gaffe. Tuwe ebimala okwetaaga kwaffe. Tuyigirize okugaba n'obugagga, okutereka n'amagezi, n'okusaasaanya n'obwegendereza. Fuula amaka gange ekifo gy'oweerwa ekitiibwa. Mu linnya lya Yesu, Amiina.
fields.body_text: "Alabirira obulungi amakubo g'ab'omu nnyumba ye, so talya mmere ya bunafu." Engero 31:27 (KJV) Essuula ey'amakumi asatu mu emu mu Ngero eleeta ekifaananyi ky'omukazi ow'ekitalo. Yamanyiddwa nga omukazi omutuukirivu oba omukazi wa Engero 31. Bba amwesiga. Abaana be bagolokoka ne bamuyita ow'omukisa. Akola n'emikono egyeteefuteefu. Agolokoka nga bukyali kiro okuteekerateekera ab'omu maka ge emmere. Alowooza ku nnimiro n'agigula. Asimba olusuku lw'emizabbibu. Akola engoye n'azitundira abasuubuzi. Agololera emikono gye abaavu n'abeetaavu. Ayambadde amaanyi n'ekitiibwa, era aseka olunaku olujja. Ono si mukazi munafu. Ono mukazi wa maanyi, ow'amagezi, omunyiikivu, era atya Katonda. Era wakati mu bulamu bwe waliwo amaka ge. Okuddukanya amaka si kuyitibwa kutono. Tekusinga bukulu okuvuga bizinensi oba okukola omulimu mu ofiisi. Mu ngeri nnyingi, kikulu okusinga, kubanga amaka ge omulembe ogujja gye gubumbirwa. Amaka ag'emirembe era agategekeddwa obulungi bujulizi bwa maanyi eri enjiri. Amaka ag'akasasamalo era ag'entalo gagoba buli omu ali mu go — bba, abaana, n'abagenyi — okulaga oluggi. fields.title: Okuyigiriza Abakazi n'Abaana
fields.body_html:
"Abakazi abakadde nabo bwe batyo babeere n'empisa ezisaanira obutukuvu, si ba kuwaayiriza, si baddu ba nvinnyo nnyingi, wabula abayigiriza ebirungi; balyoke bategeeze abakazi abato okuba ab'amagezi, okwagala ba bbaabwe, n'okwagala abaana baabwe." Tito 2:3-4 (KJV) Obumu ku buweereza obusanyizibwako ennyo mu Kkanisa leero y'obuweereza bw'abakazi Abakristaayo abakadde okuyigiriza abakazi Abakristaayo abato. Pawulo yagamba Tito, omusumba omuvubuka, nti kino kyali kya kubeera mpisa nteeketeeke mu kkanisa. Abakazi abakadde baali ba kuyigiriza abakazi abato engeri y'okwagalamu ba bbaabwe, engeri y'okwagalamu abaana baabwe, engeri y'okubeeramu ab'amagezi, ab'obwenkanya n'ab'obulongoofu, engeri y'okulabiriramu amaka gaabwe, n'engeri y'okuba abalungi. Kino si kya kulondako. Kiri mu ntegeka ya Katonda ey'engeri okukkiriza gye kuyisibwa okuva mu mulembe ogumu okutuuka ku mulala.

Lwaki Katonda alagira abakazi abakadde okuyigiriza abakazi abato? Kubanga ebintu ebimu bisinga kuyigirizibwa mukazi eri mukazi munne. Omukyala omuto ayinza obutawulira bulungi okubuuza omusumba we ku buzibu obuli mu bufumbo bwe. Maama omuggya ayinza okwetaaga amagezi ag'omugaso okuva eri oyo eyayita mu kkubo eryo emabega we. Omukristaayo omuto ayinza okwetaaga omukazi omukadde okumusabira ng'ayita mu kusalawo okuzibu.

Enkolagana zino ez'okuyigiriza za muwendo era za maanyi.

Bw'oba oli mukazi mukadde asoma kino — nga kino kitegeeza omukazi yenna eyatambulidde ne Kristo ekiseera ekiwanvu okusinga omulala omuto — olina eky'okugaba. Toyeetaaga kuba muwomboze wa ssomero lya Bayibuli. Toyeetaaga kuba mukazi wa musumba. Toyeetaaga kuba na bibuuzo byonna eby'okuddamu.

Weetaaga bwokka okuba eyatambulidde ne Mukama, okumanya Bayibuli yo, n'okuba omwetegefu okufuka mu mulembe oguddirira.

Bw'oba oli mukazi muto, noonya mwannyoko omukadde mu Mukama. Mubuuze akusisinkane, oboolyawo omulundi gumu buli mwezi oba omulundi gumu buli wiiki. Mubuuze ebibuuzo byo. Yigira ku bulamu bwe. Musabire wamu. Bayibuli atugamba nti mu bawi b'amagezi abangi mulimu obukuume. Togezaako kutambula bulamu bw'Ekikristaayo bwokka.

Bayibuli atuwa ebyokulabirako bingi eby'abakazi abayigiriza abakazi n'abaana. Lowooza ku Debola mu kitabo ky'Abalamuzi. Yali nnabbi omukazi eyalamula Isiraeri mu kiseera eky'ekizikiza ekingi. Yatuulanga wansi w'omuti gw'olukindu, abantu ne bajja gy'ali okulamulwa. Era yakulembera eggwanga mu lutalo n'omulwanyi Balaki, kubanga Balaki teyandigenze wabula nga Debola agenze naye. Debola yali maama mu Isiraeri — bwe yeeyita bw'atyo mu luyimba lwe olw'obuwanguzi. Yayigiriza abantu amakubo ga Mukama, era n'alaga obuvumu mu lutalo. Katonda akozesa abakazi ng'abayigiriza n'abakulembeze mu bantu be.

Lowooza ku Pulisikira nate. Ye ne bba Akula bwe baawulira Apolo ng'ayigiriza mu kkuŋŋaaniro — Apolo yali musajja mukugu mu kwogera eyamanyi ebyawandiikibwa naye nga tannawulira bubaka bwonna obwa Yesu n'okubatizibwa kw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu — baamuzza ku bbali ne bamunnyonnyola ekkubo lya Katonda mu ngeri esingako obutuukirivu. Pulisikira yayigiriza Apolo. Yakikola mu bukkakkamu, ng'ali wamu ne bba, si mu lukuŋŋaana lwa lwatu, naye okumanya kwe ebyawandiikibwa kwali kungi nnyo okuyigiriza omubuulizi omugabe. Abavubuka bangi bayambiddwa mu kkubo lyabwe omukazi atya Katonda eyeewaayo ekiseera okunnyonnyola ekintu kye baali tebannategeera.

Lowooza ku Nawomi ne Luusi. Luusi bwe yadda ne Nawomi e Besirekemu, yagoberera ebiragiro bya Nawomi n'obwegendereza. Nawomi yamuyigiriza ku mpisa z'Abaisiraeri. Nawomi yamuyigiriza engeri y'okutuukirira Bowaazi mu nsonga y'okununula kw'oluganda. Luusi yagondera Nawomi, ekyavaamu kwe kufumbirwa Bowaazi n'okuba n'ekifo mu lulyo lwa Kabaka Dawudi ne mu lwa Yesu Kristo. Omukazi omuto awuliriza amagezi ag'omukazi omukadde atya Katonda ateekebwa mu kkubo ery'omukisa.

Mu byafaayo by'Okuzuukuka kw'Afirika ey'Ebuvanjuba, abakazi baali ba nkulu mu kusaasaanya Enjiri. Abakazi ng'omukyala wa Bulasiyo Kigozi, n'abalala bangi amannya gaabwe agataawandiikibwa mu bitabo naye agawandiikiddwa mu ggulu, baakuŋŋaanyanga abakazi abalala okussa ekimu, okusoma Bayibuli, n'okusaba. Baagendanga okuva mu kyalo okudda mu kyalo, okuva mu nnyumba okudda mu nnyumba, nga bategeeza abakazi abalala ebya Yesu n'eby'okutambulira mu musana.

Obujulizi bwabwe obwangu era obw'obwesigwa bwakyusa Kkanisa mu Afirika ey'Ebuvanjuba.

Lowooza era ku Mary Slessor, eyagenda ng'omuweereza okuva e Sukulande okutuuka e Kalaba mu Nayijeriya eya leero mu myaka gy'ekkumi n'omunaana. Yayiga olulimi lw'abantu. Yabeera wamu nabo. Yayigiriza abakazi nti abaana ab'omulongo tebasaanidde kuttibwa nga bwe kyali empisa. Yabayigiriza ebya Yesu. Yalera abaana abaali balekeddwa awo ng'ababe. Empeereza ye ku kitundu ekyo yali nkulu nnyo n'okutuusa leero akyajjukirwa. Omukazi omu owa Sukulande omunafu naye eyali munywevu yakyusa obulamu bw'abakazi n'abaana ba Afirika enkumi n'enkumi.

Oba lowooza ku Maama Mary Stuart, eyava e Ayalandi okujja e Uganda ku ntandikwa y'emyaka gy'enkaaga mu kkumi era n'atandikawo Ssomero lya Gayaza mu 1905. Yakkiriza nti abawala ba Afirika basaanira okusomesebwa okw'Ekikristaayo nga bwe kityo abalenzi ba Afirika. Yazimba essomero abawala mwe basobola okuyigira ebyawandiikibwa, okukuza ebirowoozo byabwe, n'okwetegeka olw'obukazi obutya Katonda. Oluvannyuma lw'emyaka kikumi, Gayaza kikyali kimu ku masomero amakulembeze, era abaakisomako baba mu buli mutala gw'obulamu bwa Uganda.

Toyeetaaga kusomoka nnyanja okuba omuyigiriza w'abakazi n'abaana. Osobola okukikola mu kkanisa yo, mu kitundu ky'obeeramu, ne mu maka go. Ka nkuwe amagezi agamu ag'okukola.

Tandika n'abaana. Weeyimirize okuyamba mu Ssomero lya Ssande. Emboozi z'oyogera, ennyiriri z'oyigiriza, n'okwagala kw'olaga bijja kukola ku baana abato okumala obulamu bwabwe bwonna. Tolowooza nti okuyigiriza abaana kwa waggulu wa kutono okusinga okuyigiriza abakulu. Yesu yagamba nti obwakabaka obw'omu ggulu bwa bali abenkana bw'atyo.

Tandikawo ekibiina ekitono eky'abakazi eky'okussa ekimu. Tekyetaagisa kuba kinene. Kuŋŋaanya abakazi basatu oba bana mu nnyumba yo. Musome essuula ya Bayibuli. Mugyogereko. Musabire wamu. Mugabane essanyu lyammwe n'emigugu gyammwe.

Ekiseera nga kigenda, yita abalala okwegatta. Obumu ku buweereza bw'abakazi obusinga amaanyi mu nsi bwatandika n'abakazi babiri oba basatu abaakuŋŋaananga mu kisenge ekitono.

Yigiriza omukazi omuto omu okuba omuyigirizwa. Tunuulira mu kkanisa yo. Ani omukkiriza omuggya, oba omukyala omuto, oba maama omuggya, ayinza okuganyulwa mu mwannyina omukadde atya Katonda? Saba Mukama akulage gw'osaanidde okussaamu. Awo omuyite ku caayi. Mubuuze ebibuuzo. Mugabane bye weeyize. Tambula naye okumala ekiseera.

Yigiriza n'obulamu bwo okusooka. Pawulo yagamba Tito nti abakazi abakadde bateekwa okuba n'empisa ezisaanira obutukuvu. Toyinza kuyigiriza ky'otoli. Bw'oba oteekwa okuyigiriza abakazi abato okwagala ba bbaabwe, oteekwa okwagala owuwo. Bw'oba oteekwa okubayigiriza okulabirira abaana baabwe, oteekwa okulabirira ababo. Kino si kya kuba atuukiridde. Kiri ku kutambula ekyo ky'oyogera, okwenenya bw'ogwa, n'okuba ow'amazima.

Kozesa Katonda ky'akutadde mu ngalo. Oboolyawo olina ekirabo eky'okusembeza abagenyi — yigiriza abakazi abato okwaniriza abalala. Oboolyawo olina ekirabo eky'okusaba — bayigirize okwegayiririra abalala. Oboolyawo olina ekirabo eky'ebyawandiikibwa — bayigirize Ekigambo. Oboolyawo olina ekirabo eky'okuzzaamu amaanyi — bayigirize okuzimba mu kifo ky'okumenya. Katonda buli omu ku ffe yatuwa ekintu. Toziika talanta yo. Gikozese.

Okusaba Kitaffe, yimusa mu kkanisa zaffe abakazi abayigiriza abakazi, n'abakazi abakadde abafuka mu bakazi abato. Nnyamba okufuna n'essanyu okuva eri abo abansooka mu maaso, n'okugaba n'obwesige eri abo abanjja emabega. Mpa amagezi, obwetoowaze, n'okwagala. Okukkiriza okwaggibwa okuva ku Loyisi okutuuka ku Ewuniki okutuuka ku Timoseewo kuweebwe n'omu mulembe gwaffe.

Nfuula maama mu Isiraeri, ka mbe n'emyaka emeka, olw'Obwakabaka bwo. Mu linnya lya Yesu, Amiina.
fields.body_text: "Abakazi abakadde nabo bwe batyo babeere n'empisa ezisaanira obutukuvu, si ba kuwaayiriza, si baddu ba nvinnyo nnyingi, wabula abayigiriza ebirungi; balyoke bategeeze abakazi abato okuba ab'amagezi, okwagala ba bbaabwe, n'okwagala abaana baabwe." Tito 2:3-4 (KJV) Obumu ku buweereza obusanyizibwako ennyo mu Kkanisa leero y'obuweereza bw'abakazi Abakristaayo abakadde okuyigiriza abakazi Abakristaayo abato. Pawulo yagamba Tito, omusumba omuvubuka, nti kino kyali kya kubeera mpisa nteeketeeke mu kkanisa. Abakazi abakadde baali ba kuyigiriza abakazi abato engeri y'okwagalamu ba bbaabwe, engeri y'okwagalamu abaana baabwe, engeri y'okubeeramu ab'amagezi, ab'obwenkanya n'ab'obulongoofu, engeri y'okulabiriramu amaka gaabwe, n'engeri y'okuba abalungi. Kino si kya kulondako. Kiri mu ntegeka ya Katonda ey'engeri okukkiriza gye kuyisibwa okuva mu mulembe ogumu okutuuka ku mulala. Lwaki Katonda alagira abakazi abakadde okuyigiriza abakazi abato? Kubanga ebintu ebimu bisinga kuyigirizibwa mukazi eri mukazi munne. Omukyala omuto ayinza obutawulira bulungi okubuuza omusumba we ku buzibu obuli mu bufumbo bwe. Maama omuggya ayinza okwetaaga amagezi ag'omugaso okuva eri oyo eyayita mu kkubo eryo emabega we. Omukristaayo omuto ayinza okwetaaga omukazi omukadde okumusabira ng'ayita mu kusalawo okuzibu. Enkolagana zino ez'okuyigiriza za muwendo era za maanyi. Bw'oba oli mukazi mukadde asoma kino — nga kino kitegeeza omukazi yenna eyatambulidde ne Kristo ekiseera ekiwanvu okusinga omulala omuto — olina eky'okugaba. Toyeetaaga kuba muwomboze wa ssomero lya Bayibuli. Toyeetaaga kuba mukazi wa musumba. Toyeetaaga kuba na bibuuzo byonna eby'okuddamu. Weetaaga bwokka okuba eyatambulidde ne Mukama, okumanya Bayibuli yo, n'okuba omwetegefu okufuka mu mulembe oguddirira. Bw'oba oli mukazi muto, noonya mwannyoko omukadde mu Mukama. Bayibuli atugamba nti mu bawi b'amagezi abangi mulimu obukuume. Togezaako kutambula bulamu bw'Ekikristaayo bwokka. Bayibuli atuwa ebyokulabirako bingi eby'abakazi abayigiriza abakazi n'abaana. Ye ne bba Akula bwe baawulira Apolo ng'ayigiriza mu kkuŋŋaaniro — Apolo yali musajja mukugu mu kwogera eyamanyi ebyawandiikibwa naye nga tannawulira bubaka bwonna obwa Yesu n'okubatizibwa kw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu — baamuzza ku bbali ne bamunnyonnyola ekkubo lya Katonda mu ngeri esingako obutuukirivu. Abavubuka bangi bayambiddwa mu kkubo lyabwe omukazi atya Katonda eyeewaayo ekiseera okunnyonnyola ekintu kye baali tebannategeera. Lowooza ku Nawomi ne Luusi. Luusi bwe yadda ne Nawomi e Besirekemu, yagoberera ebiragiro bya Nawomi n'obwegendereza. Nawomi yamuyigiriza ku mpisa z'Abaisiraeri. Nawomi yamuyigiriza engeri y'okutuukirira Bowaazi mu nsonga y'okununula kw'oluganda. Luusi yagondera Nawomi, ekyavaamu kwe kufumbirwa Bowaazi n'okuba n'ekifo mu lulyo lwa Kabaka Dawudi ne mu lwa Yesu Kristo. Baagendanga okuva mu kyalo okudda mu kyalo, okuva mu nnyumba okudda mu nnyumba, nga bategeeza abakazi abalala ebya Yesu n'eby'okutambulira mu musana. Obujulizi bwabwe obwangu era obw'obwesigwa bwakyusa Kkanisa mu Afirika ey'Ebuvanjuba. Lowooza era ku Mary Slessor, eyagenda ng'omuweereza okuva e Sukulande okutuuka e Kalaba mu Nayijeriya eya leero mu myaka gy'ekkumi n'omunaana. Yayiga olulimi lw'abantu. Yabeera wamu nabo. Yayigiriza abakazi nti abaana ab'omulongo tebasaanidde kuttibwa nga bwe kyali empisa. Yabayigiriza ebya Yesu. Yalera abaana abaali balekeddwa awo ng'ababe. Empeereza ye ku kitundu ekyo yali nkulu nnyo n'okutuusa leero akyajjukirwa. Omukazi omu owa Sukulande omunafu naye eyali munywevu yakyusa obulamu bw'abakazi n'abaana ba Afirika enkumi n'enkumi. Oba lowooza ku Maama Mary Stuart, eyava e Ayalandi okujja e Uganda ku ntandikwa y'emyaka gy'enkaaga mu kkumi era n'atandikawo Ssomero lya Gayaza mu 1905. Yakkiriza nti abawala ba Afirika basaanira okusomesebwa okw'Ekikristaayo nga bwe kityo abalenzi ba Afirika. Yazimba essomero abawala mwe basobola okuyigira ebyawandiikibwa, okukuza ebirowoozo byabwe, n'okwetegeka olw'obukazi obutya Katonda. Oluvannyuma lw'emyaka kikumi, Gayaza kikyali kimu ku masomero amakulembeze, era abaakisomako baba mu buli mutala gw'obulamu bwa Uganda. fields.title: Okukuuma Omutima Gwo: Enneewulira, Olulimi, n'Omwoyo Omuteefu
fields.body_html:
"Naye mube muntu ow'omunda ow'omutima, mu ekyo ekitayonooneka, kye kyokwewunda eky'omwoyo omuteefu era omukkakkamu, ogwa muwendo mungi mu maaso ga Katonda." 1 Petero 3:4 (KJV) Ekitabo ky'Engero kitulabula okukuuma emitima gyaffe n'obwegendereza bwonna, kubanga mu mutima mwe muva ensulo ez'obulamu. Buli kintu kyonna ekiva mu kamwa ko — buli kigambo ky'oyogera eri balo, buli kunnyonnyola kw'owa omwana wo, buli kulamusa kw'olamusa muliraanwa, buli kwemulugunya kw'okola — kisooka kuva mu mutima gwo. Singa omutima gwo gujjudde emirembe, emirembe gye ginaava. Singa omutima gwo gujjudde obusungu, obusungu bwe bunaava. Singa omutima gwo gujjudde obukyayi, ebigambo eby'obukyayi bye binaava. Kkale kyeyava Mukama Yesu ayogera nti mu kujjula kw'omutima kamwa mwe koogerera.

Omukazi Omukristaayo aweereddwa, olw'ekisa kya Katonda, omutima omuggya. Bwe wajja eri Kristo, yaggyawo omutima ogw'ejjinja n'akuwa omutima ogw'ennyama. Yassa Omwoyo gwe munda mu ggwe. Naye newankubadde bwe kityo, kikugwanira okuyiga buli lunaku okutambulira mu Mwoyo so si mu mubiri. Empisa enkadde ez'obusungu, obuggya, okutya, okwesaasira, n'obukyayi tebibula mu kiseera kimu. Byteekwa okuttibwa buli lunaku ku bwalwo.

Ka njogere ku nneewulira eziwera eziyinza okuteganya Omukazi Omukristaayo, n'engeri Ebyawandiikibwa gye bituyamba okubikwatamu.

Ekisooka, obusungu. Waliwo obusungu obutuufu — Mukama Yesu yasunguwalira ab'ensimbi mu Yeekaalu. Naye obusungu bwaffe obusinga obungi tebutuukirivu. Bwa mubiri. Buva olw'amalala gaffe okulumizibwa, olw'obutafuna kye twagala, olw'omuntu okutuzza obwongo, olw'okukoowa. Ekyawandiikibwa kigamba nti, munyiige naye temwonoona, era enjuba tereganga bw'egwa nga mukyanyiize. Ekyo kitegeeza nti, kola ku busungu bwo mangu. Genda eri Katonda. Bwatule. Musabe akuyambe. Bw'oba oyonoonye omuntu mu busungu bwo, genda otabagane naye. Toleka busungu kwokerera mu mutima gwo. Bwe kunaakola bwe kityo, kunaafuuka bukyayi, era obukyayi butwa obusagwa obutta obufumbo, amaka, n'emikwano.

Ekyokubiri, okutya. Buli mukazi alina by'atya. Okutya obukuume bw'abaana be. Okutya obulamu bwe. Okutya obwavu. Okutya abantu kye banaayogera. Okutya eby'omu maaso. Ekyawandiikibwa kitugamba emirundi n'emirundi nti, totya, kubanga ndi wamu naawe. Isaaya 41:10 lwe lunyiriri olw'omuwendo okukwata ku mutwe: "Totya, kubanga ndi wamu naawe; toteganyizibwanga, kubanga nze Katonda wo; ndikugumya; weewaawo ndikuyamba; weewaawo ndikuwanirira n'omukono ogwa ddyo ogw'obutuukirivu bwange." Okutya bwe kujja, yogera ekigambo kya Katonda eri emmeeme yo. Saba. Weesige. Suula okweraliikirira kwo ku Mukama, kubanga afaayo ku ggwe.

Ekyokusatu, obuggya. Guno gwe kibi ekyekukumye era eky'akabi. Kye kibi kya Kaini, eyatta Abbeeri kubanga Katonda yakkiriza ekiweebwayo kya Abbeeri so si kikye. Kye kibi kya Miriamu, eyakwatibwa ebigenge bwe yakwatirwa obuggya Musa. Kye kibi kya baganda ba Yusufu, abaamutunda mu buddu. Obuggya bujja bwe twegerageranya n'abalala. Ono alina ennyumba esinga. Ono alina omwami asinga. Abaana be beeyisa obulungi okusinga abange. Ono alina ssente ennyingi. Ono muyonjo okusinga. Ono assibwamu ekitiibwa mu kkanisa okusinga. Ebirowoozo bino bwe bijja, byenenyeze mangu. Sanyukira wamu n'abo abasanyuka. Yeebaze Katonda ku ebyo by'akuwadde. Teweegerageranyanga na balala. Katonda alina ekkubo eryawukana eri buli muwala we.

Ekyokuna, obukyayi. Omuwandiisi w'Ebaluwa eri Abaebbulaniya atulabula okwegendereza si kulwa ng'omulandira gwonna ogw'obukyayi guvaawo ne gututeganya. Obukyayi kya bulijjo buva ku kiwundu — okulumizibwa okw'amaanyi okutawonye.

Oboolyawo omwami akusakuse. Oboolyawo ow'omu maka akubbye. Oboolyawo omusumba akuluma. Oboolyawo mukwano gwo yakulyamu olukwe. Bw'oto kole ku kiwundu ng'oyita mu kusaba, okusonyiwa, era emirundi mingi ng'oyita mu kuwabulwa Abakristaayo ab'amagezi, ekiwundu kifuuka omulandira.

Era omulandira ogwo gukula okutuusa lwe guyingiza obusagwa mu buli kimu mu bulamu bwo. Oteekwa okusonyiwa. Okusonyiwa tekitegeeza nti omuntu omulala kye yakola kyali kituufu. Tekitegeeza bulijjo nti muddamu kubeera mikwano n'omuntu oyo, naddala bwe baba beeyongera okukuluma. Okusonyiwa kitegeeza nti obakwasa Katonda era ogaana ekibi kyabwe okwongera okufuga omutima gwo.

Ekyokutaano, okwesaasira. Kino kibi kya bulijjo nnyo mu bakazi, era kyekukumye nnyo. Kyabwatuka nti, "Tewali antegeera. Tewali anfaako. Nkola nnyo naye tewali ankyaza." Okwesaasira kussa essira lyonna ku ggwe wekka. Kuliisibwa okwemulugunya kw'omu kyama. Kuvaako okwennyamira n'obukyayi. Eddagala kwe kusinza n'okuweereza. Yimusa amaaso go eri Mukama. Bala emikisa gyo.

Oluvannyuma genda oweereze omuntu omulala. Bw'ofuka obulamu bwo ku lw'abalala, Mukama ajjuza ekikompe kyo.

Kaakati ka twogere ku lulimi. Ekitabo kya Yakobo kigamba nti olulimi muliro, ye nsi ey'obutali butuukirivu.

Luyinza okuwa omukisa, era luyinza okukolimira. Luyinza okuzimba, era luyinza okumenya. Luyinza okwogera amazima, era luyinza okusaasaanya eby'obulimba. Mu bitundu byonna Omukazi Omukristaayo by'ateekwa okussa wansi w'obuyinza bwa Mukama, olulimi luyinza okuba olusinga obukulu.

Engero zitulabula emirundi n'emirundi ku mukazi omuyombi. Zigamba nti okubeera ku nsonda ku kasolya k'ennyumba kisinga okubeera n'omukazi omuyombi mu nnyumba engazi. Zigamba nti okubeera mu ddungu kisinga okubeera n'omukazi omuyombi era omunyiivu. Ekyawandiikibwa tekikambuwalira bakazi — kiwa okulabula kwe kumu eri abasajja mu ngeri endala — naye kya mazima. Omukyala alina olulimi oluyitirivu obwogi ayinza okugoba balo. Ayinza okuleetera abaana be okumutya. Ayinza okujjuza amaka ge okutabukatabuka.

Ku luuyi olulala, lowooza ku mukazi ow'omu Engero 31. Ayasamya akamwa ke n'amagezi, ne ku lulimi lwe kuli etteeka ery'ekisa. Nnyonnyola nnungi nnyo! Ebigambo bye bya magezi. Ebigambo bye bya kisa. Tayogera kulumya. Tayogera mbagirawo. Tasaasaanya bigambo. Tamenya balala. Bw'ayogera, amagezi gakulukuta.

Ka njogere mu ngeri ey'obwenkanya. Kuuma olulimi lwo mu katale, abakazi gye bakuŋŋaanira. Toyingira mu kwogera eby'olugambo ku bakazi abalala, amaka amalala, ekkanisa endala. Abalala bwe batandika okwogera eby'olugambo, noonya ensonga ey'okuvaayo, oba mpolampola kyusa omboozi. Kuuma olulimi lwo eka. Toyogera kikambwe eri balo. Toluma. Toddamu baana bo na busungu. Kuuma olulimi lwo mu kkanisa. Tovumirira musumba eri abalala. Tosaasaanya lugambo ku bammemba abalala. Kuuma olulimi lwo ku ssimu yo ne ku mukutu gwa yintaneeti. Abakazi Abakristaayo bangi bazikirizza obujulirwa bwabwe olw'ebyo bye bawandiika mu bibiina bya WhatsApp oba ku Facebook.

Lowooza ku kyokulabirako kya Malia, nnyina wa Mukama waffe. Bwe yafuna amawulire agatiisa okuva eri malayika nti anaazaala Omwana wa Katonda ng'akyali muwala embeerera atafumbiddwa, yakola ki? Teyawakana. Teyadduka kugenda ba muliraanwa. Yagamba nti, "Laba, ndi muddu wa Mukama; kikolebwe gye ndi ng'ekigambo kyo bwe kigamba." Era oluvannyuma, ebintu ebikulu bwe byabaawo okwetooloola Omwana Kristo — abasumba bwe bajja, abagezigezi bwe bajja, ebyabunyi eby'ekitalo bwe byayogerwa — Ekyawandiikibwa kigamba nti yakuuma ebintu bino byonna ng'abifumiitiriza mu mutima gwe. Yali mukazi wa mwoyo muteefu. Teyeetaaga kwogera buli kye yalowooza. Yakwata amazima munda mu mutima gwe n'agaleeta eri Katonda mu kusaba. Ogwo gwe mwoyo Mukama gw'asanyukira.

Kaakati, omwoyo omuteefu era omukkakkamu tegutegeeza mukazi atayogera n'akatono. Tegutegeeza mukazi akkiriziganya n'ekibi oba eyeeganya okulinnyirirwa. Abbigayiri yayogera n'obuvumu eri Dawudi n'awonya ab'omu maka ge. Eseza yayogera n'obuvumu eri kabaka n'awonya abantu be. Bawala ba Zerofekadi baayogera n'obuvumu eri Musa ne bafuna omugabo gwabwe. Omwoyo omuteefu era omukkakkamu gwe mwoyo oguli wansi w'obuyinza bw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Tegwanguyako kwogera. Tegwogera na busungu. Bwe gwogera, gwogera n'ekisa n'amazima wamu.

Okusaba Omwoyo Omutukuvu, jjangu okebere omutima gwange leero. Ndaga obusungu, okutya, obuggya, obukyayi, okwesaasira kwe nkkirizza okumera. Njatula ebibi bino gy'oli.

Nnaaza n'omusaayi gwa Yesu. Teeka omukuumi, ai Mukama, ku kamwa kange; kuuma oluggi lw'emimwa gyange. Mpa ekyokwewunda eky'omwoyo omuteefu era omukkakkamu, ogw'omuwendo mu maaso go. Ebigambo byange bireete obulamu so si kufa. Omutima gwange gube kifo emirembe gyo mwe gibeera. Mu linnya lya Yesu, Amiina.
fields.body_text: "Naye mube muntu ow'omunda ow'omutima, mu ekyo ekitayonooneka, kye kyokwewunda eky'omwoyo omuteefu era omukkakkamu, ogwa muwendo mungi mu maaso ga Katonda." 1 Petero 3:4 (KJV) Ekitabo ky'Engero kitulabula okukuuma emitima gyaffe n'obwegendereza bwonna, kubanga mu mutima mwe muva ensulo ez'obulamu. Buli kintu kyonna ekiva mu kamwa ko — buli kigambo ky'oyogera eri balo, buli kunnyonnyola kw'owa omwana wo, buli kulamusa kw'olamusa muliraanwa, buli kwemulugunya kw'okola — kisooka kuva mu mutima gwo. Singa omutima gwo gujjudde emirembe, emirembe gye ginaava. Singa omutima gwo gujjudde obusungu, obusungu bwe bunaava. Singa omutima gwo gujjudde obukyayi, ebigambo eby'obukyayi bye binaava. Kkale kyeyava Mukama Yesu ayogera nti mu kujjula kw'omutima kamwa mwe koogerera. Omukazi Omukristaayo aweereddwa, olw'ekisa kya Katonda, omutima omuggya. Bwe wajja eri Kristo, yaggyawo omutima ogw'ejjinja n'akuwa omutima ogw'ennyama. Yassa Omwoyo gwe munda mu ggwe. Naye newankubadde bwe kityo, kikugwanira okuyiga buli lunaku okutambulira mu Mwoyo so si mu mubiri. Empisa enkadde ez'obusungu, obuggya, okutya, okwesaasira, n'obukyayi tebibula mu kiseera kimu. Byteekwa okuttibwa buli lunaku ku bwalwo. Ka njogere ku nneewulira eziwera eziyinza okuteganya Omukazi Omukristaayo, n'engeri Ebyawandiikibwa gye bituyamba okubikwatamu. Ekisooka, obusungu. Waliwo obusungu obutuufu — Mukama Yesu yasunguwalira ab'ensimbi mu Yeekaalu. Naye obusungu bwaffe obusinga obungi tebutuukirivu. Bwa mubiri. Buva olw'amalala gaffe okulumizibwa, olw'obutafuna kye twagala, olw'omuntu okutuzza obwongo, olw'okukoowa. Ekyawandiikibwa kigamba nti, munyiige naye temwonoona, era enjuba tereganga bw'egwa nga mukyanyiize. Ekyo kitegeeza nti, kola ku busungu bwo mangu. Genda eri Katonda. Bwatule. Musabe akuyambe. Bw'oba oyonoonye omuntu mu busungu bwo, genda otabagane naye. Toleka busungu kwokerera mu mutima gwo. Bwe kunaakola bwe kityo, kunaafuuka bukyayi, era obukyayi butwa obusagwa obutta obufumbo, amaka, n'emikwano. Ekyokubiri, okutya. Buli mukazi alina by'atya. Okutya obukuume bw'abaana be. Okutya obulamu bwe. Okutya obwavu. Okutya abantu kye banaayogera. Okutya eby'omu maaso. Ekyawandiikibwa kitugamba emirundi n'emirundi nti, totya, kubanga ndi wamu naawe. Isaaya 41:10 lwe lunyiriri olw'omuwendo okukwata ku mutwe: "Totya, kubanga ndi wamu naawe; toteganyizibwanga, kubanga nze Katonda wo; ndikugumya; weewaawo ndikuyamba; weewaawo ndikuwanirira n'omukono ogwa ddyo ogw'obutuukirivu bwange." Okutya bwe kujja, yogera ekigambo kya Katonda eri emmeeme yo. Saba. Weesige. Suula okweraliikirira kwo ku Mukama, kubanga afaayo ku ggwe. Ekyokusatu, obuggya. Guno gwe kibi ekyekukumye era eky'akabi. Kye kibi kya Kaini, eyatta Abbeeri kubanga Katonda yakkiriza ekiweebwayo kya Abbeeri so si kikye. Kye kibi kya Miriamu, eyakwatibwa ebigenge bwe yakwatirwa obuggya Musa. Kye kibi kya baganda ba Yusufu, abaamutunda mu buddu. Obuggya bujja bwe twegerageranya n'abalala. Ono alina ennyumba esinga. Ono alina omwami asinga. Abaana be beeyisa obulungi okusinga abange. Ono alina ssente ennyingi. Ono muyonjo okusinga. Ono assibwamu ekitiibwa mu kkanisa okusinga. Ebirowoozo bino bwe bijja, byenenyeze mangu. Sanyukira wamu n'abo abasanyuka. Yeebaze Katonda ku ebyo by'akuwadde. Teweegerageranyanga na balala. Katonda alina ekkubo eryawukana eri buli muwala we. Ekyokuna, obukyayi. Omuwandiisi w'Ebaluwa eri Abaebbulaniya atulabula okwegendereza si kulwa ng'omulandira gwonna ogw'obukyayi guvaawo ne gututeganya. Obukyayi kya bulijjo buva ku kiwundu — okulumizibwa okw'amaanyi okutawonye. Oboolyawo omwami akusakuse. Oboolyawo ow'omu maka akubbye. Oboolyawo omusumba akuluma. Oboolyawo mukwano gwo yakulyamu olukwe. Bw'oto kole ku kiwundu ng'oyita mu kusaba, okusonyiwa, era emirundi mingi ng'oyita mu kuwabulwa Abakristaayo ab'amagezi, ekiwundu kifuuka omulandira. Era omulandira ogwo gukula okutuusa lwe guyingiza obusagwa mu buli kimu mu bulamu bwo. Oteekwa okusonyiwa. Okusonyiwa tekitegeeza nti omuntu omulala kye yakola kyali kituufu. Tekitegeeza bulijjo nti muddamu kubeera mikwano n'omuntu oyo, naddala bwe baba beeyongera okukuluma. Okusonyiwa kitegeeza nti obakwasa Katonda era ogaana ekibi kyabwe okwongera okufuga omutima gwo. Ekyokutaano, okwesaasira. Kino kibi kya bulijjo nnyo mu bakazi, era kyekukumye nnyo. Kyabwatuka nti, "Tewali antegeera. Tewali anfaako. Nkola nnyo naye tewali ankyaza." Okwesaasira kussa essira lyonna ku ggwe wekka. Kuliisibwa okwemulugunya kw'omu kyama. Kuvaako okwennyamira n'obukyayi. Eddagala kwe kusinza n'okuweereza. Yimusa amaaso go eri Mukama. Bala emikisa gyo. Oluvannyuma genda oweereze omuntu omulala. Bw'ofuka obulamu bwo ku lw'abalala, Mukama ajjuza ekikompe kyo. Kaakati ka twogere ku lulimi. Ekitabo kya Yakobo kigamba nti olulimi muliro, ye nsi ey'obutali butuukirivu. Luyinza okuwa omukisa, era luyinza okukolimira. Luyinza okuzimba, era luyinza okumenya. Luyinza okwogera amazima, era luyinza okusaasaanya eby'obulimba. Mu bitundu byonna Omukazi Omukristaayo by'ateekwa okussa wansi w'obuyinza bwa Mukama, olulimi luyinza okuba olusinga obukulu. Engero zitulabula emirundi n'emirundi ku mukazi omuyombi. Zigamba nti okubeera ku nsonda ku kasolya k'ennyumba kisinga okubeera n'omukazi omuyombi mu nnyumba engazi. Zigamba nti okubeera mu ddungu kisinga okubeera n'omukazi omuyombi era omunyiivu. Ekyawandiikibwa tekikambuwalira bakazi — kiwa okulabula kwe kumu eri abasajja mu ngeri endala — naye kya mazima. Omukyala alina olulimi oluyitirivu obwogi ayinza okugoba balo. Ayinza okuleetera abaana be okumutya. Ayinza okujjuza amaka ge okutabukatabuka. Ku luuyi olulala, lowooza ku mukazi ow'omu Engero 31. Ayasamya akamwa ke n'amagezi, ne ku lulimi lwe kuli etteeka ery'ekisa. Nnyonnyola nnungi nnyo! Ebigambo bye bya magezi. Ebigambo bye bya kisa. Tayogera kulumya. Tayogera mbagirawo. Tasaasaanya bigambo. Tamenya balala. Bw'ayogera, amagezi gakulukuta. Ka njogere mu ngeri ey'obwenkanya. Kuuma olulimi lwo mu katale, abakazi gye bakuŋŋaanira. Toyingira mu kwogera eby'olugambo ku bakazi abalala, amaka amalala, ekkanisa endala. Abalala bwe batandika okwogera eby'olugambo, noonya ensonga ey'okuvaayo, oba mpolampola kyusa omboozi. Kuuma olulimi lwo eka. Toyogera kikambwe eri balo. Toluma. Toddamu baana bo na busungu. Kuuma olulimi lwo mu kkanisa. Tovumirira musumba eri abalala. Tosaasaanya lugambo ku bammemba abalala. Kuuma olulimi lwo ku ssimu yo ne ku mukutu gwa yintaneeti. Abakazi Abakristaayo bangi bazikirizza obujulirwa bwabwe olw'ebyo bye bawandiika mu bibiina bya WhatsApp oba ku Facebook. Lowooza ku kyokulabirako kya Malia, nnyina wa Mukama waffe. Bwe yafuna amawulire agatiisa okuva eri malayika nti anaazaala Omwana wa Katonda ng'akyali muwala embeerera atafumbiddwa, yakola ki? Teyawakana. Teyadduka kugenda ba muliraanwa. Yagamba nti, "Laba, ndi muddu wa Mukama; kikolebwe gye ndi ng'ekigambo kyo bwe kigamba." Era oluvannyuma, ebintu ebikulu bwe byabaawo okwetooloola Omwana Kristo — abasumba bwe bajja, abagezigezi bwe bajja, ebyabunyi eby'ekitalo bwe byayogerwa — Ekyawandiikibwa kigamba nti yakuuma ebintu bino byonna ng'abifumiitiriza mu mutima gwe. Yali mukazi wa mwoyo muteefu. Teyeetaaga kwogera buli kye yalowooza. Yakwata amazima munda mu mutima gwe n'agaleeta eri Katonda mu kusaba. Ogwo gwe mwoyo Mukama gw'asanyukira. Kaakati, omwoyo omuteefu era omukkakkamu tegutegeeza mukazi atayogera n'akatono. Tegutegeeza mukazi akkiriziganya n'ekibi oba eyeeganya okulinnyirirwa. Abbigayiri yayogera n'obuvumu eri Dawudi n'awonya ab'omu maka ge. Eseza yayogera n'obuvumu eri kabaka n'awonya abantu be. Bawala ba Zerofekadi baayogera n'obuvumu eri Musa ne bafuna omugabo gwabwe. Omwoyo omuteefu era omukkakkamu gwe mwoyo oguli wansi w'obuyinza bw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Tegwanguyako kwogera. Tegwogera na busungu. Bwe gwogera, gwogera n'ekisa n'amazima wamu. Okusaba Omwoyo Omutukuvu, jjangu okebere omutima gwange leero. Ndaga obusungu, okutya, obuggya, obukyayi, okwesaasira kwe nkkirizza okumera. Njatula ebibi bino gy'oli. Nnaaza n'omusaayi gwa Yesu.
